a: Mishshum eva.

Bemaase yadeha. menalan? deamar rav huna amar rav: minnayin shemmaase habbat laav, shenneemar: "vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama", ma ama maase yadeha lerabbah — af bat maase yadeha leaviha. veema hane mille ketanna, dematze mezabben la, aval naara, dela matze mezabben la — maase yadeha dida havu!
Mistabbera deaviha havu, dei salka datach maase yadeha lav deaviha, ella ha dezakki leh rachamana leav lemimsera lechuppa, hechi matze masar la? ha kamvattel la mimmaase yadeha.
Parech rav achay: ema deyahev la sechar pekata. i name dimsar lah belelya. i name dimsar la beshabbatot veyamim tovim.
Ella: ketanna la tzericha kera — hasheta zabbone mezabben la, maase yadeha mibbee?! [ella] ki itzterich kera, lenaara.
Bahafarat nedareha. menalan? dichtiv: "binureha bet aviha".
Umekabbel et gittah. menalan? dichtiv: "veyatza ... vehayta", ittakkush yetzia lahavayay.

Veeno ochel perot bechayyeha. tanu rabbanan: haav eno ochel perot bechayye vitto. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: haav ochel perot bechayye vitto. bemay kamippalgi? tanna kamma savar: bishlama baal, takkinu le rabbanan pere, deim ken mimmena vela parek,
Ella av, may ikka lememar — demimmena vela parek? belav hachi parek la! verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar: av name mimmena vela parek. savar: kisa nekita illava, tezil vetifrok nafsha.

Nisset, yater alav habbaal shehu ochel kulei. tanu rabbanan: katav lah perot, kesut vechelim sheyyavou immah mibbet aviha levet balah — meta, lo zacha habbaal bidvarim hallalu. mishshum rabbi natan amru: zacha habbaal bidvarim hallalu.

Lema biflugeta derabbi elazar ben azarya verabbanan kamippalgi, ditnan: nitarmela o nitgarsha, ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin — gova et hakkol. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: min hannissuin — gova et hakkol, umin haerusin — betula gova matayim, vealmana mane,
b: Shello katav lah ella al menat lechonsah. leman deamar lo zacha — kerabbi elazar ben azarya. uman deamar zacha — kerabbanan.

La, dechulle alma kerabbi elazar ben azarya. man deamar lo zacha — kerabbi elazar ben azarya, uman deamar zacha — ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar ben azarya ella middideh ledida, shello katav lah ella al menat lechonsah.
Aval middida ledideh afillu rabbi elazar ben azarya mode, demishshum ichattone hu, veha ichattanuy lehu.
Chayyayv bimzonoteha vechulei. tanu rabbanan: tikkenu mezonoteha tachat maase yadeha, ukevuratah tachat ketubbatah, lefichach baal ochel perot.
Perot man dechar shemayyhu?! chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: tikkenu mezonoteha tachat maase yadeha, ufirkonah tachat perot, ukevuratah tachat ketubbatah. lefichach baal ochel perot.
May "lefichach"?
Mahu detema: mechol la nechlinhu, annoche nannechinhu. deim ken, mimmena vela parek, ka mashma lan deha adifa. zimnin dela malu, ufarek la middideh.
Veefoch ana!
Amar abbaye: tikkenu matzuy lematzuy, vesheeno matzuy lesheeno matzuy.

Amar rava: hay tanna savar mezonot middeorayyta, detanya: "sheerah" — ellu mezonot, vechen hu omer: "vaasher achlu sheer ammi". "kesutah" — kemashmao. "onatah" — zo ona haamura battora, vechen hu omer: "im teanne et benotay".

Rabbi elazar omer: "sheerah" — zo ona. vechen hu omer: "ish ish el kol sheer besaro lo tikrevu legallot erva". "kesutah" — kemashmao. "onatah" — ellu mezonot, vechen hu omer: "vayannecha veyarivecha".

a: Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: "sheerah kesutah" — lefum sheerah ten kesutah, shello yitten lah lo shel yalda lizkenah, velo shel zekena leyalda. "kesutah veonatah" — lefum onatah ten kesutah, shello yitten chadashim bimot hachamma, velo shechakim bimot haggeshamim.

Tane rav yosef: "sheerah" — zo keruv basar, shello yinhag bah minhag parsiyyim shemmeshammeshin mittotehen bilvushehen. mesayyay leh lerav huna, deamar rav huna: haomer "i efshi ella ani bevigdi vehi bevigdah" — yotzi venoten ketubba.
Rabbi yehuda omer: afillu ani shebbeyisrael vechulei. mikkelal detanna kamma savar hane la. hechi dame? i deorcha — may tama detanna kamma deamar la? vei delav orcha — may tama derabbi yehuda?
La tzericha: kegon deorcheh dideh velav orcha dida, tanna kamma savar: ki amrinan ola immo veenah yoredet immo — hane mille mechayyim, aval leachar mita — lo.
Verabbi yehuda savar: afillu leachar mita. amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: halacha kerabbi yehuda.

Veamar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: mi shennishtatta — bet din yordin linchasav vezanin umefarnesin et ishto uvanav uvenotav, vedavar acher. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: may shena meha detanya: mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot — bet din yordin linchasav, vezanin umefarnesin et ishto, aval lo banav uvenotav, velo davar acher?
Amar leh: vela shane lach ben yotze ledaat layyotze shello ledaat?
May "davar acher"? rav chisda amar: ze tachshit. rav yosef amar: tzedaka. man deamar tachshit, kol shekken tzedaka. man deamar tzedaka, aval tachshit yahavinan la, dela nicha leh detinnavvavl.
Amar rav chiyyay bar avin amar rav huna: mi shehalach limdinat hayyam umeta ishto — bet din yordin linchasav, vekovrin otah lefi chevodo. lefi chevodo velo lefi chevodah?
Ema: af lefi chevodo. ha ka mashma lan: ola immo veenah yoredet immo, vaafillu leachar mita.
Amar rav matna, haomer: "im meta, lo tikberuha minnechasav" — shomin lo. may shena ki amar — denafli nichse kamme yatme. ki la amar name, nichse kamme yatme remu?
Ella: haomer: "im met hu, lo tikberuhu minnechasav" — en shomin lo. lav kol hemennu sheyyaashir et banav veyappil atzmo al hatztzibbur.
Mishna leolam hi birshut haav ad shettikkanes
b: Lirshut habbaal lenissuin. masar haav lishluche habbaal — hare hi birshut habbaal. halach haav im sheluche habbaal, o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal — hare hi birshut haav. masru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal — hare hi birshut habbaal.
Gemara may leolam? leappoke mimmishna rishona. ditnan: higgia zeman velo nisseu — ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma. ka mashma lan, leolam.
Masar haav lishluche habbaal, hare hi birshut habbaal vechulei. amar rav: mesiratah lakkol, chutz mitteruma. verav assi amar: af litruma.

Etiveh rav huna lerav assi, veamri la chiyyay bar rav lerav assi: leolam hi birshut haav ad shettikkanes lachuppa! amar lehu rav: lav amena lechu la tezlu batar ippecha?! yachevl leshannoye lechu: mesiratah, zo hi kenisatah lechuppa.
Ushemuel amar: lirushshatah.
Resh lakish amar: lichtubbatah. ketubbatah may hi? dei meta yaret la, hayeynu dishmuel! amar ravina: lomar ketubbatah meacher mane.
Rabbi yochanan verabbi chanina deamri tarvayyhu: mesiratah lakkol, af litruma.

Metivi: halach haav im sheluche habbaal, o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal, o shehayta lah chatzer badderech venichnesa immo lalin, af al pi shekketubbatah bevet balah, meta — aviha yorshah.
Masar haav lishluche habbaal, o shemmasru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal, o shehayta lo chatzer badderech venichnesa immo leshum nissuin, af al pi shekketubbatah bevet aviha, meta — balah yorshah.
Bamme devarim amurim — lirushshatah, aval litruma, en ishsha ochelet bitruma ad shettikkanes lachuppa. teyuveta dechullehu! teyuveta.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat nichnesa immo lalin. tama delalin, ha setama — leshem nissuin. ema sefa: nichnesa immo leshem nissuin, ha setama, lalin.
Amar rav ashe: setame setame katane. setam chatzer dida — lalin. setam chatzer dideh — lenissuin.
Tanna: masar haav lishluche habbaal vezinneta — hare zo bechenek. mena hane mille? amar rabbi amme bar chama, amar kera: "liznot bet aviha", perat leshemmasar haav lishluche habbaal.
Veema: perat shennichnesa lachuppa velo nivala!
Amar rava: amar li amme, chuppa behedya ketiva: "ki yihye naara vetula meorasa leish". "naara" — velo bogeret, "betula" — velo beula, "meorasa" — velo nesua.
May "nesua"? ilema nesua mammash, hayeynu "betula" velo beula! ella lav, shennichnesa lechuppa velo nivala.

a: Veema: hecha dehadra leve nasha — hadra lemilleta kammayyta? amar rava: hahu kevar paska tanna deve rabbi yishmael,
Detana deve rabbi yishmael: "veneder almana ugerusha kol asher asra al nafshah yakum aleha", ma talmud lomar? vahalo mutzet mikkelal av umutzet mikkelal baal!

Ella, hare shemmasar haav lishluche habbaal, o shemmasru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal, venitarmela badderech o nitgarsha, heach ani kore bah: bet aviha shel zo, o bet balah shel zo? ella lomar lecha: kevan sheyyatza shaa achat mershut haav — shuv eno yachol lehafer.

Amar rav pappa af anan name tenena: habba al naara hameorasa — eno chayyayv ad shettehe naara betula meorasa, vehi bevet aviha. bishlama "naara" — velo bogeret, "betula" — velo beula, "meorasa" — velo nesua. "bevet aviha" lemaote may? lav lemaote masar haav lishluche habbaal?!

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, af anan name tenena: habba al eshet ish, kevan shennichnesa lirshut habbaal lenissuin, af al pi shello nivala — habba aleha hare ze bechenek. nichnesa lirshut habbaal bealma shema minna.

Mishna haav eno chayyayv bimzonot bitto. ze midrash darash rabbi elazar ben azarya lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne: habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu. ma habbanim enan yorshin ella leachar mitat haav — af habbanot en nizzonot ella leachar mitat avihen.
Gemara bimzonot bitto hu deeno chayyayv, ha bimzonot beno — chayyayv. bitto name: chova hu delekka, ha mitzva ikka. manni matnitin? la rabbi meir, la rabbi yehuda, vela rabbi yochanan ben beroka.

Detanya: mitzva lazun et habbanot, kal vechomer labbanim — deaski battora, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: mitzva lazun et habbanim, vekal vachomer labbanot — mishshum ziluta. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: chova lazun et habbanot leachar mitat avihen, aval bechayye avihen — ellu vaellu enan nizzonin.
Manni matnitin? i rabbi meir ha amar banim mitzva?! i rabbi yehuda, ha amar banim name mitzva! i rabbi yochanan ben beroka, afillu mitzva name lekka!
Ibbaet ema rabbi meir, ibbaet ema rabbi yehuda, ibbaet ema rabbi yochanan ben beroka.
Ibbaet ema rabbi meir vehachi kaamar: haav eno chayyayv bimzonot bitto, vehu haddin livno. ha mitzva bevitto ikka, kal vachomer labbanim. vehay dekatane bitto — ha ka mashma lan:
b: Daafillu bitto, chova hu delekka, ha mitzva ikka.

Veibbaet ema rabbi yehuda, vehachi kaamar: haav eno chayyayv bimzonot bitto, vechol shekken livno. ha mitzva bivno ikka, vekal vachomer labbanot. veha dekatane bitto — ha ka mashma lan daafillu bitto chova lekka.

Veibbaet ema rabbi yochanan ben beroka, vehachi kaamar: eno chayyayv bimzonot bitto, vehu haddin livno. vehu haddin daafillu mitzva name lekka, veayyeyde devanot leachar mitat avihen chova, tena name eno chayyayv.

Amar rabbi ila amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda bar chanina: beusha hitkinu sheyyehe adam zan et banav veet benotav keshehen ketannim. ibbaya lehu: hilcheta kevoteh o en hilcheta kevoteh? ta shema: ki hava atu lekammeh derav yehuda amar lehu: yarud yalda, veabbene mata shadya?!

Ki hava atu lekammeh derav chisda, amar lehu: kefo leh asita betzibbura, velekum velema: orva bae beneh vehahu gavra la bae beneh?! veorva bae beneh? vehachtiv: "livne orev asher yikrau"! la kashya, ha bechivvare, ha beukkame.
Ki hava ate lekammeh derava, amar leh: nicha lach demittazni benaych mitztzedaka?
Vela amaran, ella dela amid, aval amid — kafenan leh al kurcheh. ki ha derava kafyeh lerav natan bar amme veappek minneh arba mea zuze litzdaka.
Amar rabbi ila amar resh lakish: beusha hitkinu hakkotev kol nechasav levanav — hu veishto nizzonim mehem.
Matkef la rabbi zera veittema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: gedola mizzo amru, almenato nizzonet minnechasav, hu veishto mibbaya?!
Dishlach ravin beiggarteh: mi shemmet vehinniach almana uvat — almenato nizzonet minnechasav. nisset habbat — almenato nizzonet minnechasav.
Meta habbat, amar rabbi yehuda ben achoto shel rabbi yose bar chanina: al yadi haya maase, veamru: almenato nizzonet minnechasav. hu veishto mibbaya?!
Mahu detema: hatam hu delekka detarach, aval hacha — nitrach ledideh uledida, ka mashma lan.

Ibbaya lehu: hilcheta kevoteh o let hilcheta kevoteh? ta shema: derabbi chanina verabbi yonatan havo kayymi, ata hahu gavra gechen venashshekeh lerabbi yonatan akkareh, amar leh rabbi chanina: may hay? amar leh: kotev nechasav levanav hu,

a: Veassitinhu (lezuneh) [vezanu]. i amrat bishlama lav dina, mishshum hachi assiynhu. ella i amrat dina — assoyinhu bae?

Amar rabbi ila, beusha hitkinu: hamevazbez — al yevazbez yoter mechomesh. tanya name hachi: hamevazbez — al yevazbez yoter mechomesh, shemma yitztarech labberiyyot. umaase beechad shebbikkesh levazbez [yoter mechomesh], velo hinniach lo chavero. umannu — rabbi yeshevav. veamri la: rabbi yeshevav, velo hinnicho chavero, umannu — rabbi akiva.
Amar rav nachman, veittema rav acha bar yaakov, may kera: "vechol asher titten li asser aasserennu lach".
Veha la dame issura batra leissura kamma! amar rav ashe: "aasserennu" levatra ki kamma.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: ushemuot hallalu mitmaatot veholchot. vesimanaych: ketannim katvu uvizbezu.

Amar rav yitzchak, beusha hitkinu sheyyehe adam mitgalgel im beno, ad shetem esre shana. mikkan veelach, yored immo lechayyav. ini?! veha amar leh rav lerav shemuel bar shilat: betzir mibbar shet — la tekabbel. bar shet — kabbel usefi leh ketora!
In, safe leh ketora, mihu eno yored immo lechayyav ad leachar shetem esre shana. veibbaet ema, la kashya: ha lemikra, ha lemishna.
Deamar abbaye, amara li em: bar shet — lemikra, bar eser — lemishna, bar telesar — letaanita meet leet. uvetinoket — bat teresar.

Amar abbaye, amara li em: hay bar shet detarka leh akrabba beyoma demishlam shet — la chaye. may asuteh — merarta dedayya chivvarta beshichra, nishpeyeh venashkeyeh. hay bar shatta detarek leh zibbura beyoma demishlam shatta — la chaye. may asuteh — atzvata dedikla bemayya, nishpeyeh venashkeyeh.

Amar rav kattina: kol hammachnis et beno pachut mibben shesh — ratz acharav veeno maggio. ikka deamri: chaverav ratzin acharav veen maggiin oto. vetarvayyhu itanhu: chalish ugemir. ibbaet ema: ha dichchish, ha devari.

Amar rabbi yose bar chanina, beusha hitkinu: haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah umeta, habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot. ashkecheh rav yitzchak bar yosef lerabbi avahu dahava kae beuchelusa deusha, amar leh: man mara dishmata deusha? amar leh: rabbi yose bar chanina. tena minneh arbein zimnin, vedame leh keman demannecha leh bechisteh.

"Ashre shomre mishpat ose tzedaka vechol et". vechi efshar laasot tzedaka bechol et? darshu rabbotenu shebbeyavne, veamri la rabbi eliezer: ze hazzan banav uvenotav keshehen ketannim. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ze hamegaddel yatom vitoma betoch beto umassian.
"Hon vaosher beveto vetzidkato omedet laad". rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: ze hallomed tora umelammedah. vechad amar: ze hakkotev tora neviim uchetuvim umashilan laacherim.

"Uree vanim levanecha shalom al yisrael". amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kevan shevanim levanecha" — "shalom al yisrael". dela ate lide chalitza veyibbum. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: kevan shevanim levanecha" — shalom al dayyayne yisrael, dela ate leinnetzoye.
Ze midrash darash rabbi elazar lifne chachamim kulei.
b: Yatev rav yosef kammeh derav hamenuna veyatev rav hamenuna, vekaamar: keshem sheen habbanim yorshin ella min hakkarka — kach en habbanot nizzonot ella min hakkarka. avavsh aleh kulle alma: deshavek ara — hu deyarti leh beneh, dela shavek ara — la yarti leh beneh?!
Amar leh rav yosef: vedilma ketubbat benin dichrin kaamar mar?! amar leh: mar, degavra rabba hu, yada may kaamena.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef: rav zan mechitte daaliyyay. ibbaya lehu: parnasa havay, umay aliyyay — meilluyay deav, uchedishmuel. deamar shemuel: lefarnasa, shamin baav.
O dilma mezone mammash hava, umay aliyyay — middevarim tovim shenneemru baaliyyay. deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef: baaliyyay hitkinu sheyyehu banot nizzonot min hammittaltelin.
Ta shema: bideh derabbi bannay achu derabbi chiyyay bar abba havo mittaltelin deyatme. ato lekammeh dishmuel. amar leh: zil zun.
May lav limzone, vechidrav yitzchak bar yosef sevira leh? la, hatam lefarnasa havay. ushemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: lefarnasa shamin baav.
Hava ovada binhardea, vedun dayyayne dinhardea. befumebdita, veagbi rav chana bar bizna. amar lehu rav nachman: zilu ahdaru, vei la — magbena lechu leappadnayychu minnayychu.
Rabbi amme verabbi assi sevur lemezan mimmittaltele. amar lehu rabbi yaakov bar idi: milleta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish la avadu bah ovada attun avdin ba ovada?!

Rabbi elazar savar lemezan mimmittaltelin. amar lefanav rabbi shimon ben elyakim: rabbi, yodea ani becha sheen middat haddin atta ose, ella middat rachmanut. ella, shemma yiru hattalmidim veyikbeu halacha ledorot.
Hahu daata lekammeh derav yosef, amar lehu: havu la mittamre deal budeya, amar leh abbaye: illu baal chov hava ki hay gavvna, mi hava yahev leh mar?
Amar leh: dechazyay levudeya kaamena.

a: Sof sof, kol haomed ligzoz kegazuz dame! ditzricha ledikla kaamena.

Hahu yatom vitoma daato lekammeh derava. amar lehu rava: haalu layyatom bishvil yetoma. amri leh rabbanan lerava: veha mar hu deamar mimmekarkee vela mimmittalteli, ben limzone ben lichtubba uven lefarnasa!
Amar lehu: illu ratza shifcha leshammesho, mi la yahavinan leh? kol shekken hacha deikka tarte.

Tanu rabbanan: echad nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut, veechad nechasim sheen lahen achrayut — motziin limzon ishsha ulevanot, divre rabbi. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut — motziin labbanot min habbanim, velabbanot min habbanot, velabbanim min habbanim.
Velabbanim min habbanot binchasim merubbin, aval lo labbanim min habbanot binchasim muatin.
Nechasim sheen lahen achrayut motziin labbanim min habbanim, velabbanot min habbanot, velabbanim min habbanot. aval lo labbanot min habbanim.
Af al gav dekayyma lan halacha kerabbi mechavero, hacha halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar. deamar rava, hilcheta: mimmekarkee vela mimmetalteli, ben lichtubba, ben limzone, ben lefarnasa.

Mishna lo katav lah ketubba — betula gova matayim, vealmana mane, mippene shehu tenay bet din. katav lah sade shave mane tachat matayim zuz, velo katav lah "kol nechasim deit li achrain lichtubbetich" — chayyayv, shehu tenay bet din.
Lo katav lah: "im tishtevay, efrekinnich veotvinnich li leintu", uvechohenet: "ahderinnich limdinticha" — chayyayv, shehu tenay bet din.
Nishbet — chayyayv lifdotah. veim amar: hare gittah uchetubbatah, vetifde et atzmah — eno rashshay. lakta — chayyayv lerappeotah. amar: "hare gittah uchetubbatah, terappe et atzmah" — rashshay.
Gemara manni — rabbi meir hi, deamar: kol happochet livtula mimmatayim ulealmana mimmane — hare zo beilat zenut.
Dei rabbi yehuda, haamar: ratza, kotev livtula shetar shel matayim, vehi kotevet "hitkabbalti mimmecha mane". ulealmana mane, vehi kotevet: "hitkabbalti mimmecha chamishshim zuz".

Ema sefa: katav lah sade shave mane tachat matayim zuz, velo katav lah "kol nechasim deit li achrain lichtubbetich"  — chayyayv, shehu tenay bet din. atan lerabbi yehuda, deamar: achrayut taut sofer hu.
Dei rabbi meir, haamar: achrayut — lav taut sofer hu. ditnan: matza shitre chov — im
b: Yesh bahen achrayut nechasim — lo yachazir, shebbet din nifrain mehen.
En bahen achrayut nechasim — yachazir, sheen bet din nifrain mehen, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze lo yachazir, shebbet din nifrain mehen.
Resha rabbi meir vesefa rabbi yehuda! vechi tema kulla rabbi meir hi, veshane leh lerabbi meir ben ketubba lishtare. umi shane leh?
Vehatanya: chamishsha govin min hamechorarin, veellu hen: perot, ushevach perot, vehamekabbel alav lazun et ben ishto uvat ishto, veget chov sheen bo achrayut, uchetubbat ishsha sheen bah achrayut.
Man shamat leh deamar achrayut lav taut sofer hu — rabbi meir, vekatane ketubbat ishsha.
Ibbaet ema rabbi meir, veibbaet ema rabbi yehuda. ibbaet ema rabbi yehuda: hatam katva leh "hitkabbalti", hacha la katva leh "hitkabbalti".
Ibbaet ema rabbi meir: may "chayyayv" dekatane — min hamechorarin.
Lo katav lah vechulei. amar avu dishmuel: eshet yisrael shenneensa — asura levalah. chayyshinan shemma techillatah beones vesofah beratzon.
Etiveh rav laavu dishmuel: "im tishtevay, efrekinnich veotvinnich li leintu"! ishtik.
Kare rav aleh daavu dishmuel: "sarim atzru vemillim vechaf yasimu lefihem". may it leh lememar? bishvuya hekellu.
Velaavu dishmuel, ones desharya rachamana hechi mashkachat la? kegon dekaamri edim betzovachat mittechilla vead sof.
Ufeliga derava. deamar rava: kol shettechillatah beones vesof [beratzon, afillu] hi omeret: hannichu lo, sheilmale (lo) nizkak lah hi socharto, mutteret. may tama — yetzer albesha.
Tanya kevoteh derava "vehi lo nitpasa", asura. ha nitpasa — mutteret. veyesh lecha acheret, sheaf al pi shello nitpasa — mutteret, veezo — zo kol shettechillatah beones vesofah beratzon.
Tanya iddach: "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura, ha nitpasa — mutteret. veyesh lecha acheret, sheaf al pi shennitpasa — asura, veezo — zo eshet kohen.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabbi yishmael: "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura, ha nitpasa — mutteret. veyesh lah acheret, sheaf al pi shello nitpasa, mutteret. veezo — zo shekkiddusheha kiddushe taut, sheafillu benah murekav al ketefah — memaenet veholechet lah.

Amar rav yehuda: hane neshe dignavu gannave — sharyayn leguverayyhu. amri leh rabbanan lerav yehuda: veha ka mamteyan lehu nahama! mechamat yira. veha ka meshallechan lehu gire! mechamat yira. vadday, shavkinhu veazlan minnafshayyhu — asiran.
Tanu rabbanan: shevuye malchut — hare hen kishvuyin. genuve listut — enan kishvuyin. vehatanya ippecha!
Malchut ammalchut la kashya: ha bemalchut achashverosh, ha bemalchut ben netztzar.
Listut allistut la kashya: ha beven netztzar, ha belistim dealma. uven netztzar, hatam kare leh melech, vehacha kare leh listim! in, gabbe achashverosh — listim hu, gabbe listim dealma — melech hu.
Uvechohenet ahderinnich limdinticha vechulei. amar abbaye: almana lechohen gadol — chayyayv lifdotah, sheani kore bah "uvechohenet ahderinnich limdinticha",

a: Mamzeret unetina leyisrael — eno chayyayv lifdotah, sheen ani kore bah "veotvinnich li leintu". rava amar: kol sheissur sheviyyay gorem lah — chayyayv lifdotah, issur davar acher gorem lah — eno chayyayv lifdotah.
Lema ketannae: hammaddir et ishto venishbet — rabbi eliezer omer: podah, venoten lah ketubbatah. rabbi yehoshua omer: noten lah ketubbatah, veeno podah.
Amar rabbi natan, shaalti et somchos: kesheamar rabbi yehoshua noten lah ketubbatah veeno podah, keshehiddirah ulevassof nishbet, o benishbet ulevassof hiddirah?
Veamar li: lo shamati, venirin devarim shehiddirah ulevassof nishbet. dei amrat nishbet ulevassof hiddirah — ate leiarome.
May lav: bemaddir eshet kohen kamippalgi, veabbaye deamar kerabbi eliezer, verava deamar kerabbi yehoshua?
La, hacha bemay askinan? kegon shennadra ihi, vekayyem la hu. rabbi eliezer savar: hu noten etzba ben shinneha. verabbi yehoshua savar: hi natna etzba ben shinneha.
I hi natna etzba ben shinneha — ketubba may avidta?
Vetu, amar rabbi natan, shaalti et somchos: kesheamar rabbi yehoshua noten lah ketubbatah veeno podah, keshehiddirah ulevassof nishbet, o beshennishbet ulevassof hiddirah? veamar: lo shamati.
Vei dindara ihi, ma li hiddirah ulevassof nishbet, ma li nishbet ulevassof hiddirah?

Ella, leolam deaddera ihu. veabbaye metaretz letameh, verava metaretz letameh. abbaye metaretz letameh: almana lechohen gadol kulle alma la peligi dechayyayv lifdotah, mamzeret unetina leyisrael kulle alma la peligi deeno chayyayv lifdotah. maddir eshet kohen name, kulle alma la peligi dechayyayv lifdotah. dehayynu almana [lechohen gadol].
Ki peligi bemaddir eshet yisrael. rabbi eliezer azel batar meikkara, verabbi yehoshua azel batar bassof.
Rava metaretz letameh: almana lechohen gadol, mamzeret unetina leyisrael — kulle alma la peligi deeno chayyayv lifdotah. ki peligi bemaddir, ben eshet kohen uven eshet yisrael.
Rabbi eliezer azel batar meikkara, verabbi yehoshua azel batar bassof.

Nishbet chayyayv lifdotah vechulei. tanu rabbanan: nishbet bechayye balah, veachar kach met balah. hikkir bah baalah — yorshin chayyayvin lifdotah. lo hikkir bah baalah — en yorshin chayyayvin lifdotah.

Levi savar lemibad ovada ki ha matnita. amar leh rav, hachi amar chabbivi: let hilcheta ki ha matnita, ella ki ha detanya: nishbet leachar mitat balah — en hayyetomin chayyayvin lifdotah. velo od, ella afillu nishbet bechayye balah, veachar kach met balah — en hayyetomin chayyayvin lifdotah. sheen ani kore bah "veotvinnich leintu".
Tanu rabbanan: nishbet, vehayu mevakkeshin mimmennu ad asara bedameha, paam rishona — podah. mikkan veelach: ratza podah, ratza eno podah. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer:
b: En podin et hashshevuyin yoter al kede demehem, mippene tikkun haolam. ha bichde demehen podin, af al gav defirkonah yoter al ketubbatah.

Ureminhi: nishbet, vehayu mevakkeshin mimmennu ad asara bichtubbatah, paam rishona — podah. mikkan veelach: ratza podah, ratza eno podah. rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer: im haya pirkonah keneged ketubbatah — podah, im lav eno podah!
Rabban shimon ben gamliel tere kulle it leh.

Lakta chayyayv lerappeotah. tanu rabbanan: almana nizzonet minnichse yetomin utzericha refua — hare hi kimzonot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: refua sheyyesh lah kitzva (nitrappet) [titrappe] — mikketubbatah, sheen lah kitzva — hare hi kimzonot.

Amar rabbi yochanan: asu hakkazat dam beeretz yisrael kirfua sheen lah kitzva. kariveh derabbi yochanan hava lehu ittat abba dahavat tzericha refua kol yoma. ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar lehu: ezilu kutzu leh midde lerofe.
Amar rabbi yochanan: asinu atzmenu keorche haddayyaynin. meikkara may sevar, ulevassof may sevar? meikkara sevar: "umibbesarcha lo titallam", ulevassof sevar: adam chashuv shane.

Mishna lo katav lah "benin dichrin deyihvo lichi minnay innun yirtun kesef ketubbetich yater al chulakhon deim achuhon" — chayyayv, shehu tenay bet din. "benan nukevan deyihvoyn lichi minnay yehevyan yatvan beveti umittaznan minnichsay ad detillakchan leguverin" — chayyayv, shehu tenay bet din.

"At tehe yatva beveti umittazna minnichsay kol yeme megar almenutich beveti" — chayyayv, shehu tenay bet din. kach hayu anshe yerushalayim kotvin. anshe galil hayu kotvin keanshe yerushalayim. anshe yehuda hayu kotvin: "ad sheyyirtzu hayyorshin litten lich ketubbetich". lefichach im ratzu yorshin — notnin lah ketubbatah ufotrin otah.
Gemara amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: mippene ma hitkinu ketubbat benin dichrin — kede sheyyikpotz adam veyichtov levitto kivno.
Umi ikka midde derachamana amar bera lerot beratta la terot, vaato rabbanan umetakkeni deterot beratta?
Ha name deorayyta hu, dichtiv: "kechu nashim veholidu banim uvanot ukechu livnechem nashim veet benotechem tenu laanashim". bishlama banim — bideh kayymi. ella benateh, mi kayyman bideh?
Ha ka mashma lan, denalbesha venichasseya venittev la midde, ki hechi dekaftzi ala veatu nasvi la. vead kamma? abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: ad leissur nichse.
Veema: deav lerot, devaal la lerot! im ken, av name mimmena vela katev.
Veema: hecha dichtav av — lichtov baal, hecha dela ketav av — la lichtov baal! la pelug rabbanan.
Bat ben habbanim name terot? kenachala shavveyuha rabbanan.
Bat ben habbanot terot! la pelug rabbanan. vetigbe mimmittalteli? kichtubba shavveyuha rabbanan.
Titrof mimmeshabedi! "yirtun" tenan. veema af al gav delekka motar dinar! bemakom deka miakra nachala deorayyta, la takkinu rabbanan.
Rav pappa iasak leh livreh be abba suraa. azel lemichtav la ketubbeta. shema yehuda bar marimar, nefak ata itchazi leh. ki meto lefitcha, hava ka mippetar minneh. amar leh: neul mar bahaday!

a: Chazyeh dela hava nicha leh, amar leh: may dataych — mishshum daamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, la tihve beabbore achsanta afillu mibbera bisha livra tava — dela yedia may zara nafek minneh, vechol shekken mibbera livratta,

Hay name takkanta derabbanan hi, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: amar leh: hane mille middateh. leassoyeh name? amar leh: attu mi kaamena lach deul veasseyeh? ul vela teasseyeh kaamena. amar leh: maalay didi hayeynu issuyeh.
Achpeyeh veol. ishtik vitev. sevar hahu mirtach ratach. katveh lechol may dahava leh. lesof amar leh: hasheta name la mishtae mar? chayye demar, la shevayki midde lenafshay.
Amar leh: i minnay didi — afillu hay name dichtavt la nicha li. amar leh: hasheta name ehdar bi. amar leh: shauoye nafshach haderana — la kaamena.
Bea minneh rav yemar sava merav nachman: machra ketubbatah levalah, yesh lah ketubbat benin dichrin o en lah ketubbat benin dichrin? amar leh rava: vetibbee lach mochelet.
Amar leh: hasheta, mocheret kamibbaya li, deaf al gav deikka lememar zuze ansuha, deamena keman deka machu la mea uchele beuchela, mochelet mibbaya?!
Amar rava, peshita li: mocheret ketubbatah laacherim — yesh lah ketubbat benin dichrin. may tama — zuze ansuha. mochelet ketubbatah levalah — en lah ketubbat benin dichrin, may tama — achole achelta.
Bae rava: mocheret ketubbatah levalah, kemocheret laacherim dame, o kemochelet levalah dame? batar devaya hadar pashta: mocheret ketubba levalah, kemocheret laacherim dame.
Metiv rav idi bar avin: meta — en yorshin shel ze veen yorshin shel ze yorshin ketubbatah. vehavenan ba: ketubbatah may avidta?!
Veamar rav pappa: ketubbat benin dichrin. veammay? hacha name lema yetzer ansa!
Hatam, kenasa hu dekansuha rabbanan.

Yatev ravin bar chanina kammeh derav chisda, veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi elazar: mochelet ketubbatah levalah — en lah mezonot. amar leh: i lav dekaamrat li mishshemeh degavra rabba, hava amena lach: "meshiv raa tachat tova lo tamush raa mibbeto"?!

Yatev rav nachman veulla vaavimi bar rav pappe, veyatev rav chiyyay bar amme gabbayyhu. ata hahu gavra dishchiva arusato, amri leh: zil kevar, o hav lah ketubbeta. amar lehu rav chiyyay, tenena: ishto arusa — lo onen velo mittamme la, vechen hi — lo onenet velo mittammea lo. meta — eno yorshah, met hu — gova ketubbatah.
Tama demet hu, ha meta hi — en lah ketubba. may tama? amar rav hoshaya: sheen ani kore bah "lichshettinnasi leacher titteli ma shekkatuv lichi".
Ki ata ravin, amar resh lakish: arusa shemmeta — en lah ketubba. amar lehu abbaye, zilu imru leh:
b: Shekila tevutach shadya achizre, kevar targema rav hoshaya lishmateh bevavel.
Benan nukevan deyihveyayn lichi minnay vechulei. rav tane: "ad detillakchan leguverin", velevi tane: "ad detivgeran". lerav, af al gav divgar?! velevi, af al gav deinnesiv?!

Ella: begar vela innesiv, innesiv vela begar — dechulle alma la peligi. ki peligi baarusa vela begar. vechen tane levi bematniteh: "ad detivgeran veyimte zimnehon deinnasvan". tarte? ella: o tivgeran o yimte zimnehon leitnasva.
Ketannae: ad matay habbat nizzonet — ad shetteares, mishshum rabbi elazar amru: ad shettivgar. tane rav yosef: "ad dihevvyayn". ibbaya lehu: havaya deerusin, o havaya denissuin? teku.

Amar leh rav chisda lerav yosef: mi shemia lach minneh derav yehuda, arusa yesh lah mezonot, o en lah mezonot? amar leh: mishma la shemia li, ella missevara let la: kevan deersa, la nicha leh detittezil.
Amar leh: im mishma la shemia lach, missevara it la. kevan dela kim leh begavva, la shade zuze bichdi.

Veikka deamri, amar leh: mishma la shemia li, missevara it la — kevan dela kim leh begavva, la shade zuze bichdi. amar leh: i mishma la shemia lach, missevara let la. kevan deersa, la nicha leh detittezil.
Siman degavre: shak zeraf. meana, vivama, sheniyya, arusa, vaanusa.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: memaenet, yesh lah mezonot, o en lah mezonot?

Amar lehu rav sheshet, tenetuha: almana bevet aviha, ugerusha bevet aviha, veshomeret yavam bevet aviha — yesh lah mezonot. rabbi yehuda omer: odah bevet aviha — yesh lah mezonot, enah bevet aviha — en lah mezonot.
Rabbi yehuda hayeynu tanna kamma?! ella lav, memaenet ikka benayyhu, detanna kamma savar it la, verabbi yehuda savar let la.
Bae resh lakish: bat yevamah, yesh lah mezonot o en lah mezonot?
Kevan deamar mar ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon, let la, o dilma: kevan dei let la merishon, takkinu la rabbanan mishsheni, it la? teku.
Bae rabbi elazar: bat sheniyya, yesh lah mezonot, o en lah mezonot?

a: Kevan delet la ketubba — let la mezone, o dilma: imma daavada issura — kansuha rabbanan, ihi, dela avada issura — la kansuha rabbanan. teku.
Bae rava: bat arusa, yesh lah mezonot, o en lah mezonot? kevan deit la ketubba — it la, o dilma: kevan dela takkinu rabbanan ketubba ad sheat nissuin — let la, teku.
Bae rav pappa: bat anusa, yesh lah mezonot, o en lah mezonot? allibba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda la tibbee lach, deamar yesh lah ketubba mane.
Ki tibbee lach, allibba derabbanan deamri: yatza kesef kenasah bichtubbatah, may?
Kevan delet la ketubba, let la mezone, o dilma: ketubba tama may — kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah, veha — la matze mappek la. teku.
At tehe yatva beveti vechulei. tane rav yosef: "beveti" — vela bevikti, aval mezone it la. mar bar rav ashe amar: afillu mezone name let la. velet hilcheta kemar bar rav ashe.

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: tevauha lehinnase venitpayyeysa — en lah mezonot. ha lo nitpayyeysa, yesh lah mezonot? amar rav anan: ledidi mipparsha li minneh demar shemuel: amra "mechamat peloni bali" — yesh lah mezonot, "mechamat bene adam sheenan mehugganin lah" — en lah mezonot.
Amar rav chisda: zinneta — en lah mezonot. amar rav yosef: kichala ufirkesa — en lah mezonot.
Man deamar zinneta, kol shekken kichala ufirkesa. man deamar kichala ufirkesa, aval zinneta it la, may tama — yetzer ansa.
Velet hilcheta kechol hane shematata, ella ki ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hattovaat ketubbatah bevet din — en lah mezonot.
Vela?! vehatanya: machra ketubbatah, umishkena ketubbatah, asta ketubbatah appoteke leacher — en lah mezonot. hane — in, aval tovaat — la!
Hane, ben bevet din ben shello bevet din. tovaat, bevet din — in, shello bevet din — la.
Vechach hayu anshe yerushalayim vechulei. ittemar, rav amar: halacha keanshe yehuda, ushemuel amar: halacha keanshe galil.
Bavel vechol parvodeha nehug kerav, nehardea vechol parvodeha nehug kishmuel. hahi bat machoza dahavat nesiva linhardea. ato lekammeh derav nachman, shama lekala devat machoza hi.
Amar lehu: bavel vechol parvodeha nehug kerav. amaru leh: veha linhardea nesiva! amar lehu: i hachi, nehardea vechol parvodeha nehug kishmuel. vead hecha nehardea — ad hecha desage kabba dinhardea.
Ittemar. almana, rav amar: shamin ma shealeha. ushemuel amar: en shamin ma shealeha. amar rav chiyyay bar avin: vechillufah belakit.
Rav kahana matne: vechen belakit. umannach ba simana: "yatma vearmalta shelach ufok".

Amar rav nachman: af al gav ditnan bematnitin kevoteh dishmuel, hilcheta kevoteh derav. ditnan: echad hammakdish nechasav, veechad hammaarich et atzmo — en lo lo bichsut ishto, velo bichsut banav, velo betzeva shetztzava lishman, velo besandalim chadashim shellakach lishman.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: vechi meachar ditnan matnitin kevoteh dishmuel, ammay hilcheta kevoteh derav? amar leh: lichora kishmuel rehita, ki meayyeynat bah — hilcheta kevoteh derav.
May tama? ki akni la, addata lemekam kammeh. addata lemishkal ulemippak — la akni la.

Kalleta deve bar elyashiv hava ka tava ketubbeta miyyatme. hava ka mamteya lehu leve dina, amri: zila lan milleta detezli hachi. azala leveshtinhu veikkassitinhu lechulleh mana. ato lekammeh deravina, amar lehu: hilcheta kevoteh derav, deamar: almana shamin ma shealeha.
Hahu daamar lehu: "neduneya livrat". zal neduneya. amar rav idi bar avin: purena leyatme.
Hahu daamar lehu:
b: "Arba mea zuze min chamra livrat". iyyaykkar chamra. amar rav yosef: ravvcha leyatme.
Kariveh derabbi yochanan hava lehu ittat abba dahava kamafseda mezone. ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan. amar lehu: ezilu veemaru leh laavuchon dinyayched la ara limzona.

Ato lekammeh deresh lakish, amar lehu: kol shekken sheribba lah mezonot. amaru leh: veha rabbi yochanan la amar hachi! amar lehu: zilu havu la. vei la, mappekna lechu rabbi yochanan meunnayychu. ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar lehu: ma eese? shekkenegdi chaluk alay.
Amar rabbi avahu: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yochanan. amar "limzonot" — ribba lah mezonot. amar "bimzonot" — katzatz lah mezonot.
Hadaran alach naara

Af al pi sheamru betula gova matayim vealmana mane, im ratza lehosif afillu mea mane — yosif. nitarmela o nitgarsha, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin — gova et hakkol. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: min hannissuin — gova et hakkol, min haerusin — betula gova matayim vealmana mane, shello katav lah ella al menat lechonsah.

Rabbi yehuda omer: im ratza kotev livtula shetar shel matayim, vehi kotevet "hitkabbalti mimmecha mane", ulealmana mane vehi kotevet "hitkabbalti mimmecha chamishshim zuz". rabbi meir omer: kol happochet livtula mimmatayim ulealmana mimmane — hare zo beilat zenut.
Gemara peshita? mahu detema: kitztzuta avadu rabbanan shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo, ka mashma lan.
Im ratza lehosif kulei. "ratza lichtov lah" la katane, ella "ratza lehosif". mesayyay leh lerabbi ayvu amar rabbi yannay. deamar rabbi ayvu amar rabbi yannay: tenay ketubba kichtubba dame.
Nafka minna: lemocheret; ulemochelet; lemoredet;
Ulefogemet; letovaat; uleoveret al dat;

a: Leshevach; lishvua; velishviit;
Ulechotev kol nechasav levanav; ligbot min hakkarka umin hazzibburit; vechol zeman shehi bevet aviha; velichtubbat benin dichrin.
Ittemar. ketubbat benin dichrin, pumebdita amri: la tarfa mimmeshabedi, "yirtun" tenan.
Bene mata machseya amri: tarfa mimmeshabedi, "yissevun" tenan. vehilcheta: la tarfa mimmeshabedi, "yirtun" tenan.
Mittalteli veitanhu beenayyhu — bela shevua,
Letanhu beenayyhu — pumebdita amri: belo shevua. bene mata machseya amri: bishvua. vehilcheta: belo shevua.
Yayched la ara bearbea mitzraneha — bela shevua. bechad mitzra — pumebdita amri: bela shevua. bene mata machseya amri: bishvua. vehilcheta: bela shevua.

Amar leedim "kitvu vechitmu vehavu leh", keno minneh — la tzerich immeloche beh. la keno minneh — pumebdita amri: la tzerich immeloche beh, bene mata machseya amri: tzerich immeloche beh. vehilcheta: tzerich immeloche beh.
Rabbi elazar ben azarya vechulei. ittemar. rav verabbi natan, chad amar: halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya, vechad amar: en halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya.
Tistayyem derabbi natan hu deamar halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya, deshaminan leh lerabbi natan deazel batar umedana. deamar rabbi natan: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri bimsukkan,
b: Uvitrumat maaser shel demay.
Verav la azel batar umedana? veha ittemar: mattenat shechiv mera shekkatuv bah kinyan, beve rav mishshemeh derav amri: arkeveh attere richshe. ushemuel amar: la yadana may edun ba.
Beve rav mishshemeh derav amri, arkeveh attere richshe: hare hi kemattenat bari, vahare hi kemattenat shechiv mera.
Hare hi kemattenat bari, deim amad — eno yachol lachazor bo. hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera, sheim amar "halevaati lifloni" — halevaato lifloni.
Ushemuel amar: la yadana may edun ba, shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar, veen shetar leachar mita.

a: Ella: tarvayyhu azli batar umedana.
Man deamar halacha — shappir, man deamar en halacha — hacha name umedan data hu. mishshum ikkarove data hu, veha ikkarava leh data.
Yatev rav chanina kammeh derabbi yannay vekaamar: halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya. amar leh: pok, keri keraach levara! en halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya.
Amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi mishshum rabbenu: halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya. amar rav nachman amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya.

Verav nachman dideh amar: en halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya. unehardae mishshemeh derav nachman amri: halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya. veaf al gav delat rav nachman veamar: kol dayyayna dedaen kerabbi elazar ben azarya hachi vehachi tehve, afillu hachi — halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya. vahalacha lemaase kerabbi elazar ben azarya.
Bae ravin: nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala, mahu? chibbat chuppa kona, o chibbat bia kona.

Ta shema, detane rav yosef: shello katav lah ella al chibbat layla harishon. i amrat bishlama chibbat chuppa kona — hayeynu deamar layla harishon, ella i amrat chibbat bia kona, bia — belayla harishon ita, mikkan veelach leta?!
Veella may, chuppa? chuppa belelya ita, bimama leta? uletamaych — bia belelya ita, bimama leta? ha amar rava, im haya bevayit afel muttar! ha la kashya: orach ara ka mashma lan, devia ballayla.
Ella chuppa kashya? chuppa name la kashya: kevan distam chuppa levia kayyma, orach ara ka mashma lan devallayla.
Bae rav ashe: nichnesa lechuppa ufersa nidda, mahu? im timtze lomar chibbat chuppa kona, chuppa dechazya levia, aval chuppa dela chazya levia — la, o dilma la shena? teku.
Rabbi yehuda omer: ratza, kotev livtula vechulei. vesavar rabbi yehuda dechotvin shovar? vehatnan: mi sheppara miktzat chovo — rabbi yehuda omer: yachlif. rabbi yose omer: yichtov lo shovar!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: kesheshshovartah mittochah.

Abbaye amar: afillu tema besheen shovartah mittochah, bishlama hatam, vadday pareh — dilma mirchas tavarta, umappek leh lishtara, vahadar gave zimna acharina. hacha, vadday yehav la? milleta bealma hi daamara leh, i natreh — natreh, i la natreh — ihu hu deafsed annafsheh.
Bishlama abbaye la amar kerabbi yirmeya, la katane shovartah mittochah. ella rabbi yirmeya may tama la amar keabbayye? gezera shovar dehacha attu shovar dealma.
Tama — dechatva leh, aval al pe — la. ammay? davar shebbemamon hu, veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar: davar shebbemamon — tenao kayyaym.

Detanya: haomer leishsha "hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheen lich alay sheer kesut veona" hare zo mekuddeshet, utenao batel, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: bedavar shebbemamon — tenao kayyaym!
Kasavar rabbi yehuda: ketubba derabbanan, vachachamim asu chizzuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora.

Hare perot derabbanan, vela avadu lehu rabbanan chizzuk! ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: leolam hu ochel pere ferot — ad sheyyichtov lah: "din udevarim en li binchasayich, uveferotehen, uveferot perotehen ad olam".
b: Vekayyma lan: may "kotev" — omer!
Amar abbaye: lakkol yesh ketubba, velo lakkol yesh perot. milleta dishchicha — avadu ba rabbanan chizzuk, milleta dela shechicha — la avadu ba rabbanan chizzuk.
Hare chammarim, dishchichi, vela avadu la rabbanan chizzuk!
Ditnan: hachammarin shennichnesu lair, veamar echad mehen: shelli chadash, veshel chaveri yashan. shelli eno metukkan, veshel chaveri metukkan en neemanim. rabbi yehuda omer: neemanim.
Amar abbaye: vadday dedivrehem — avadu rabbanan chizzuk. safek dedivrehem, la avadu rabbanan chizzuk. rava amar: bidmay hekellu.
Rabbi meir omer: kol happochet vechulei. kol happochet afillu bitnaa — alma kasavar tenao batel, veit la. vechevan deamar la "let lich ella mane" — la samcha data, vehavya la beilato beilat zenut.
Veha shaminan leh lerabbi meir deamar: kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora — tenao batel. ha bidrabbanan — tenao kayyaym?! kasavar rabbi meir ketubba deorayyta.

Tanya, rabbi meir omer: kol happochet livtula mimmatayim ulealmana mimmane — hare zo beilat zenut. rabbi yose omer: rashshay. rabbi yehuda omer: ratza, kotev livtula shetar shel matayim, vehi kotevet lo: "hitkabbalti mimmecha mane", ulealmana mane, vehi kotevet lo: "hitkabbalti mimmecha chamishshim zuz".
Vesavar rabbi yose rashshay? ureminhi: en osin ketubbat ishsha mittaltelin, mippene tikkun haolam. amar rabbi yose: vechi ma tikkun haolam yesh bezo? vahalo en ketzuvin ufochatin!

Tanna kamma name "en osin" kaamar! ella lav hachi kaamar: bamme devarim amurim — beshello kibbel alav achrayut, aval kibbel alav achrayut — osin. vaata rabbi yose lememar ki kibbel alav achrayut ammay osin? vahalo en ketzuvin ufochatin!
Hasheta, uma hatam dedilma pachati — chayesh rabbi yose, hacha, devadday ka pachata — lo kol shekken?! hachi hasheta?! hatam la yada detachel, hacha yada veka machala.
Achateh derame bar chama havat nesiva lerav avya.

a: Irchas ketubbeta. ato lekammeh derav yosef, amar lehu: hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre rabbi meir.
Aval chachamim omrim: meshahe adam et ishto shetayim veshalosh shanim belo ketubba. amar leh abbaye: veha amar rav nachman amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi meir bigzerotav! i hachi, zil ketov la.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: machloket battechilla, aval bassof — ledivre hakkol enah mochelet. verabbi yochanan amar: ben bazo uven bazo machloket. amar rabbi avahu: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yochanan daana verabbi yehoshua ben levi la peliginan ahadade:
May "battechilla" dekaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi — techillat chuppa, umay "sof" — sof bia. vechi kaamena ana ben bazo uven bazo machloket, techillat chuppa vesof chuppa, dehi techillat bia.

Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: machloket levassof, aval battechilla — divre hakkol mochelet, verabbi yochanan amar: ben bazo uven bazo machloket. amar rabbi avahu: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yochanan, daana verabbi yehoshua ben levi la peliginan ahadade: may "levassof" deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi — sof chuppa, umay "techilla" — techillat chuppa. vechi kaamena ana ben bazo ben bazo machloket — techillat bia vesof bia.

Amar rav pappa: i lav deamar rabbi avahu "ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yochanan daana verabbi yehoshua ben levi la peliginan ahadade", hava amena: rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi peligi, rav dimi veravin la peligi.
May "sof" dekaamar ravin — sof chuppa, umay "techilla" dekaamar rav dimi — techillat bia.
May ka mashma lan?
Ha ka mashma lan, difligi tere amorae attama denafshayyhu, vela peligi tere amorae allibba dechad amora.

Mishna notnin labbetula shenem asar chodesh mishshettevaah habbaal, lefarnes et atzmah. ucheshem shennotnin laishsha — kach notnin laish lefarnes et atzmo. ulealmana sheloshim yom. higgia zeman velo nisseu — ochlot mishshello, veochlot bitruma.
Rabbi tarfon omer: notnin lah hakkol teruma. rabbi akiva omer: mechetza chullin umechetza teruma.

Hayyavam eno maachil bitruma. asta shishsha chodashim bifne habbaal veshishsha chodashim bifne hayyavam, vaafillu kullan bifne habbaal chaser yom echad bifne hayyavam, o kullan bifne hayyavam chaser yom echad bifne habbaal — enah ochelet bitruma.
Zo mishna rishona. bet din shel acharehen amru:
b: En haishsha ochelet bitruma ad shettikkanes lachuppa.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav chisda, deamar kera: "vayyomer achiha veimmah teshev hannaara ittanu yamim o asor".
May "yamim"? illema tere yome, mishtae inish hachi? amaru leh: tere yome, amar lehu: la. amaru leh asra yome?! ella may "yamim" — shana, dichtiv: "yamim tihye geullato".
Veema chodesh, dichtiv "ad chodesh yamim". amri: danin "yamim" setam miyyamim" setam, veen danin "yamim" setam miyyamim" shenneemar bahen chodesh.

Amar rabbi zera, tana: ketanna, ben hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev. bishlama ihi matze meakkeva, ella aviha — i ihi nicha la, aviha may nafka leh minna? savar: hasheta la yada, limchar mimmarda venafka, veatya venafla illavay.

Amar rabbi abba bar levi: en poskin al hakketanna lehassiah keshehi ketanna, aval poskin al hakketanna lehassiah keshehi gedola. peshita? mahu detema: lechush dilma meayyeyla pachda mehasheta vechalsha, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav huna: bagra yom echad venitkaddesha — notnin lah sheloshim yom, kealmana. metivi: bagra hare hi kitvua. may lav, kitvua divtula? la, kitvua dealmana.

Ta shema: bogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh, rabbi eliezer omer: hoil vechayyayv balah bimzonoteha — yafer! ema: bogeret vesheshshahata shenem asar chodesh, rabbi eliezer omer: hoil vvalah chayyayv bimzonoteha — yafer.

Ta shema: hameares et habbetula, ben shettevaah habbaal vehi meakkevet, uven shettava hi uvaal meakkev — notnin lah shenem asar chodesh mishsheat tevia, aval lo mishsheat erusin. uvagra, hare hi kitvua. ketzad: bagra yom echad venitkaddesha — notnin lah shenem asar chodesh, velaarusa sheloshim yom. teyuveta derav huna teyuveta.
May "velaarusa sheloshim yom"? amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: bogeret sheavru aleha shenem asar chodesh bevagrut venitkaddesha — notnin lah sheloshim yom kealmana.

Higgia zeman velo nisseu. amar ulla: devar tora, arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma, shenneemar: "vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo", vehay name kinyan kaspo hu. ma taam amru enah ochelet — shemma yimzegu lah kos bevet aviha, vetashke leachiha velaachotah.
I hachi, higgia zeman velo nisseu name! hatam, ducheta meyayched la.
Ella meatta, lakit kohen leyisrael la lechol bitruma, dilma atu lemechal bahadeh! hasheta middidhu safu leh — middideh achli?!
Rav shemuel bar rav yehuda amar: mishshum simpon.
I hachi, nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala name! hatam, mivdak badek la vahadar meayyel.

Ella meatta, eved kohen shellekacho miyyisrael la lechol bitruma, mishshum simpon! simpon baavadim lekka, dei deabbaray — ha kachaze leh. vei degavvay — limlacha ka bae, veshebbasseter la ichpat leh. nimtza gannav o

a: Kuveyusetus — higgio. may ikka — listim mezuyyayn o muchetav lammalchut, hanhu kala it lehu.
Mikkedi, ben lemar uven lemar la achla, may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu kibbel, masar, vehalach.
Rabbi tarfon omer: notnin lah hakkol teruma vechulei. amar abbaye: machloket bevat kohen lechohen, aval bevat yisrael lechohen — divre hakkol mechetza chullin umechetza teruma.
Veamar abbaye: machloket baarusa, aval binsua — divre hakkol mechetza chullin umechetza teruma.

Tanya name hachi, rabbi tarfon omer: notnin lah hakkol teruma. rabbi akiva omer: mechetza chullin umechetza teruma. bamme devarim amurim — bevat kohen lechohen, aval bat yisrael lechohen — divre hakkol mechetza chullin umechetza teruma. bamme devarim amurim — baarusa, aval binsua — divre hakkol mechetza chullin umechetza teruma.

Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: notnin lah shete yadot shel teruma, veachat shel chullin. rabbi yehuda omer: noten lah hakkol teruma, vehi mocheret velokachat baddamim chullin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol makom shehuzekra teruma — notnin lah kiflayim bechullin.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu tircha.
Hayyavam eno maachil bitruma. may tama? "kinyan kaspo" amar rachamana, vehay kinyan deachiv hu.
Asta shishsha chodashim bifne habbaal. hasheta bifne habbaal amrat la, bifne hayyavam mibbaya?! "zo veen tzarich lomar zo" katane.
Zo mishna rishona kulei. may tama? amar ulla, veittema rav shemuel bar yehuda: mishshum simpon.
Bishlama leulla, kammayyta shemma yimzegu lah kos bevet aviha, uvatrayyta mishshum simpon.
b: Ella lerav shemuel bar yehuda, kammayyta mishshum simpon uvatrayyta mishshum simpon, may benayyhu?
Ikka benayyhu bedikat chutz. mar savar: bedikat chutz — shemah bedika. umar savar: bedikat chutz — lo shemah bedika.
Mishna hammakdish maase yede ishto — hare zo osa veochelet. hammotar, rabbi meir omer: hekdesh, rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer: chullin.

Gemara amar rav huna amar rav: yechola ishsha lomar levalah "eni nizzonet veeni osa". kasavar: ki takkinu rabbanan mezone — ikkar, umaase yadeha mishshum eva. vechi amra "eni nizzonet veeni osa" — harshut beyadah.
Metivi: tikkenu mezonot tachat maase yadeha! ema: tikkenu maase yadeha tachat mezonot.
Lema mesayyay leh: hammakdish maase yede ishto — hare hi osa veochelet. may lav, benizzonet? la, besheenah nizzonet.

I besheenah nizzonet, may lememra? afillu leman deamar yachol harav lomar laeved "ase immi veeni zanach" — hane mille beeved kenaani, dela ketiv beh "immach", aval eved ivri, dichtiv beh "immach" — la, vechol shekken ishto!
Sefa itzterich leh: motar, rabbi meir omer: hekdesh, rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer: chullin.

Ufeliga deresh lakish. deamar resh lakish: la tema tama derabbi meir mishshum dekasavar adam makdish davar shello ba laolam. ella tama derabbi meir, mittoch sheyyachol lechuppah lemaase yadeha — naasa keomer lah "yikdeshu yadayich leosehem".
Veha la amar la hachi! kevan deshaminan leh lerabbi meir deamar: en adam motzi devarav levattala — naase keomer lah "yikdeshu yadayich leosehem".

Vesavar rabbi meir en adam makdish davar shello ba laolam? vehatanya, haomer leishsha: "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer", o: "leachar shettitgayyeyri", "leachar sheeshtachrer", "leachar shettishtachreri", "leachar sheyyamut balich", o "shettamut achotich", o: "leachar sheyyachlotz lich yevamich", rabbi meir omer: mekuddeshet.
Mehahi — in, meha lekka lemishma minna.
Hammotar, rabbi meir omer hekdesh. emat kadosh? rav ushemuel deamri tarvavyyhu: motar leachar mita kadosh. rav adda bar ahava amar: motar mechayyim kadosh.
Have ba rav pappa: bemay? ilema bemaale lah mezonot umaale lah maa kesef litzracheha — may tama deman deamar leachar mita kadosh?
Veella kesheen maale lah mezonot velo maale lah maa kesef litzracheha — may tama deman deamar mechayyim kadosh?
Leolam bemaale lah mezonot veeno maale lah maa kesef litzracheha. rav ushemuel savri: tikkenu

a: Mezonot tachat maase yadeha, umaa kesef tachat motar, vechevan dela ka yahev la maa kesef — motar dida have. rav adda bar ahava savar: tikkenu mezonot tachat motar, umaa kesef tachat maase yadeha, vechevan deka yahev la mezone, motar dideh have.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: midde dishchiach mimmidde dishchiach. umar savar: midde dekiytz mimmidde dekiytz.
Metivi: tikkenu mezonot tachat maase yadeha! ema: tachat motar maase yadeha.
Ta shema: im eno noten lah maa kesef litzracheha — maase yadeha shellah. ema: motar maase yadeha shellah. veha ala katane: ma hi osa lo — mishkal chamesh selaim sheti bihuda!
Hachi kaamar: maase yadeha kamma have, delidda motar dida kamma — mishkal chamesh selaim sheti bihuda, shehen eser selaim baggalil.
Amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yochanan hassandelar.

Umi amar shemuel hachi? vehatnan: "kuvnnam sheani osa leficha" — eno tzarich lehafer. rabbi akiva omer: yafer, shemma taadif alav yater min harauy lo. rabbi yochanan ben nuri amar: yafer, shemma yegarshenna utehe asura lachazor.
Veamar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri. ki amar shemuel halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri, lehaedafa.
Velema: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri lehaedafa! i name: en halacha ketanna kamma! i name: halacha kerabbi akiva!
Ella, amar rav yosef: kuvnnamot kaamrat? shane kuvnnamot, mittoch sheadam oser perot chavero alav, adam makdish davar shello ba laolam.
Amar leh abbaye: bishlama adam oser perot chavero alav — shekken adam oser perotav al chavero. yeesor davar shello ba leolam al chavero, shekken en adam oser perot chavero al chavero?
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: beomeret "yikdeshu yaday leosehem", deyadayim itanhu baolam.
Vechi kaamra hachi mi makdesha? ha meshabeda leh! deamra lechi miggarsha.
Umi ikka midde deillu hasheta la kaddish ulekammeh kaddish? amar rabbi ilay: allema la? illu haomer lachavero "sade zo sheani mocher lecha lichsheekkachenna mimmecha tikdash", mi la kadsha?

Matkef la rabbi yirmeya: mi dame? hatam, beyado lehakedishah. hacha, en beyadah legaresh et atzmah. ha la damya ella laomer lachavero "sade zo shemmacharti lecha, lichsheekkachenna mimmecha — tikdash", dela kadsha.
Matkef la rav pappa: mi dame? hatam, gufa uferot bida delokeach. hacha, gufa bida hu. ha la damya ella laomer lachavero
b: "Sade zo shemmishkanti lecha, lichsheefdenna mimmecha — tikdash", dekadsha.

Matkef la rav shisha bereh derav idi: mi dame? hatam, beyado lifdotah. hacha, en beyadah legaresh atzmah! ha la damya ella laomer lachavero "sade zo shemmishkanti lecha leeser shanim, lichsheefdenna mimmecha — tikdash", dekadsha.
Matkef la rav ashe: mi dame? hatam, leeser shanim miha beyado lifdotah. hacha, en beyadah legaresh atzmah leolam.
Ella, amar rav ashe: kunnamot ka amrat? shane kunnamot, dikdushshat hagguf ninhu, vechidrava. deamar rava: hekdesh, chametz veshichrur — mafkiin mide shibud.
Venikdeshu mehasheta? allemuha rabbanan leshibudeh devaal, ki hechi dela tikdash mehasheta.

Mishna veellu melachot shehaishsha osa levalah: tochenet, veofa, umechabbeset, mevashshelet, umenika et benah, matztzaat lo hammitta, veosa batztzemer. hichnisa lo shifcha achat — lo tochenet velo ofa velo mechabbeset. shetayim — en mevashshelet, veen menika et benah. shalosh — en matztzaat lo hammitta, veen osa batztzemer. arba — yoshevet bekatedra.

Rabbi eliezer omer: afillu hichnisa lo mea shefachot — kofah laasot batztzemer, shehabbattala mevia lide zimma. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af hammaddir et ishto millaasot melacha — yotzi veyitten ketubba, shehabbattala mevia lide shiamum.
Gemara tochenet salka datach?! ella ema: matchenet. veibbaet ema: berichya dida.

Matnitin dela kerabbi chiyyay, detane rabbi chiyyay: en ishsha ella leyofi, en ishsha ella levanim. vetane rabbi chiyyay: en ishsha ella letachshite ishsha. vetane rabbi chiyyay: harotze sheyyeadden et ishto — yalbishenna kele fishtan. harotze sheyyalbin et bitto — yaachilenna efrochim veyashkenna chalav samuch lefirkah.

Umenika et benah. lema matnitin dela kevet shammay. detanya: nadra shello lehanik et benah, bet shammay omrim: shometet dad mippiv. bet hillel omrim: kofah umenikato. nitgarsha — eno kofah. veim haya makkirah — noten lah secharah vechofah, umenikato mippene hassakkana.
Afillu tema bet shammay, hacha bemay askinan: kegon shennadra hi, vekiyyem la hu. vekasavri bet shammay: hu noten etzba ben shinneha, uvet hillel savri: hi natna etzba ben shinneha.
Veniflegu bichtubba bealma. veod: tanya, bet shammay omrim: enah menika! ella mechavvavrta matnitin dela kevet shammay.
Im haya makkirah.

a: Ad kamma? amar rava amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: shelosha chodashim, ushemuel amar: sheloshim yom. verabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: chamishshim yom. amar rav shimi bar abbaye: halacha kerabbi yitzchak sheamar mishshum rabbi yochanan. bishlama rav verabbi yochanan — kol chad vechad ki churepeh. ella lishmuel, ki hay gavvna mi mashkachat la?
Ki ata rame bar yechezkel, amar: la tetzitinhu lehane kelale dechayel yehuda achi mishshemeh dishmuel. hachi amar shemuel: kol zeman shemmakkirah.

Hahi daatay lekammeh dishmuel. amar leh lerav dimi bar yosef: zil bidke. azal otva bedare dinshe, veshakleh livra vekamhaddar leh alayyhu. ki meta legabba, havat ka mesavve leappa kevashtinhi leena minneh. amar la: netof enich, kum deray berich. some mena yada? amar rav ashe: berecha uvetama.

Tanu rabbanan: yonek tinok veholech ad esrim vearbaa chodesh, mikkan veelach — keyonek sheketz, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer: afillu arba vechamesh shanim. perash leachar esrim vearbaa chodesh vechazar — keyonek sheketz.

Amar mar: mikkan veelach keyonek sheketz. ureminhi: yachol yehe chalev mehalleche shetayim tame. vedin hu: uma behema shehekalta bemaggaah — hechmarta bachalavah, adam shehechmarta bemaggao — eno din shettachmir bachalavo?

Talmud lomar: "et haggamal ki maale gera hu", hu tame, veen chalev mehalleche shetayim tame, ella tahor. yachol otzi et hechalav, sheeno shave bakkol, velo otzi et haddam shehu shave bakkol — talmud lomar "hu" — hu tame, veen dam mehalleche shetayim tame, ella tahor.
Veamar rav sheshet: afillu mitzvat perisha en bo.
La kashya: ha defaresh, ha dela paresh.
Vechillufa bedam. kidtanya: dam sheal gabbe kikkar — gorro veochlo. shebben hashshinnayim — motztzo veeno choshesh.
Amar mar, rabbi yehoshua omer: afillu arba vechamesh shanim. vehatanya, rabbi yehoshua omer: afillu chavilato al ketefav! idde veidde chad shiura hu. amar rav yosef: halacha kerabbi yehoshua.
Tanya, rabbi marinus omer: goneach — yonek chalav beshabbat. may tama: yonek mefarek kilachar yad, uvimkom tzaara la gezaru rabbanan. amar rav yosef: halacha kerabbi marinus.

Tanya, nachum ish galya omer: tzinnor shealu bo kashkashshin — memaachan beraglo betzina beshabbat, veeno choshesh. may tama — metakken kilachar yad hu, uvimkom peseda la gezaru ba rabbanan. amar rav yosef: halacha kenachum ish galya.

Perash leachar esrim vearbaa chodesh vechazar — keyonek sheketz. vechamma? amar rav yehuda bar chaviva amar shemuel: shelosha yamim. ikka deamri, tane rav yehuda bar chaviva kammeh dishmuel: shelosha yamim.
Tanu rabbanan: meneket shemmet balah betoch esrim vearbaa chodesh — hare zo lo titares velo tinnase
b: Ad esrim vearbaa chodesh, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yehuda mattir bishmona asar chodesh. amar rabbi natan bar yosef: hen hen divre bet shammay, hen hen divre bet hillel. shebbet shammay omrim: esrim vearbaa chodesh, uvet hillel omrim: shemona asar chodesh.

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: ani achria. ledivre haomer esrim vearbaa chodesh — mutteret linnase beesrim veechad chodesh. ledivre haomer bishmona asar chodesh — mutteret lehinnase bachamishsha asar chodesh, lefi sheen hechalav nekar ella leachar shelosha chodashim.

Amar ulla: halacha kerabbi yehuda. veamar mar ukeva: li hittir rabbi chanina laset leachar chamishsha asar chodesh. ariseh deabbaye ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: mahu leares bachamishsha asar chodesh? amar leh: chada, derabbi meir verabbi yehuda — halacha kerabbi yehuda. veod: bet shammay uvet hillel — halacha kevet hillel. veamar ulla: halacha kerabbi yehuda, veamar mar ukeva: li hittir rabbi chanina laset leachar chamishsha asar chodesh, kol shekken deat leares.

Ki ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: tzericha lehametin esrim vearbaa chodesh, chutz miyyom shennolad bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo. rehat batreh telata parse veamri la parsa bechala, vela adrecheh.

Amar abbaye: hay milleta daamur rabbanan afillu beata bechuttacha la lishre inish bimkom rabbeh, la mishshum demichaze keafkiruta, ella mishshum dela mistayyeya milleta lememra. deha ana hava gemirna leh leha derav ushemuel, afillu hachi la mistayyeya li milleta lememar.

Tanu rabbanan: natna benah lemeneket, o gemalattu, o met — mutteret linnase miyyad. rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua sevur lemibad ovada ki ha matnita. amara lehu hahi savta: bedidi hava ovada, vaasar li rav nachman.
Ini?! veha rav nachman shera lehu leve resh galuta! shane be resh galuta dela hadri behu.

Amar lehu rav pappe: veattun la tisberuha — meha detanya: hare shehayta redufa lelech levet aviha, o shehaya lah kaas bevet balah, o shehaya balah chavush bevet haasurin, o shehalach balah limdinat hayyam, o shehaya balah zaken, o chole, o shehayta akara uzekena ayylonit uketanna, vehammappelet achar mitat balah, vesheenah reuya leled — kullan tzerichot lehametin shelosha chodashim, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yose mattir leares velinnase miyyad. veamar rav nachman amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi meir bigzerotav.

Amri leh: lav addatin. vehilcheta: met — muttar, gemalattu — asur. mar bar rav ashe amar: afillu met name asur, dilma katla leh veazla uminnasva. hava ovada vachanakteh. vela hi, hahi shota havay, dela avdi neshe dechankan benayyhu.
Tanu rabbanan: hare shennatnu lah ben lehanik — hare zo lo tanik immo lo benah velo ben chavertah. paska kima — ochelet harebe. lo tochal immo devarim haraim lechalav.
Hasheta benah amrat la, ben chavertah mibbaya?! mahu detema: benah hu dechayysa[1] illaveh mamtzeya leh tefe. aval ben chavertah, i lav dahava la motar la hava mamtzeya leh, ka mashma lan.
Paska kima — ochelet harebe. mehecha? amar rav sheshet: mishshellah.

Lo tochal immo devarim haraim. may ninhu? amar rav kahana: kegon keshut vachaziz vedagim ketannim vaadama. abbaye amar: afillu kara vachavusha. rav pappa amar: afillu kora vechufera. rav ashe amar: afillu kamka veharesana. minnayyhu paski chalava, minnayyhu achri chalava.

Dimshammesha be richya — havu la bene nichpe. dimshammesha al ara — havu la bene shemute. dedarcha al (rema) [dema] dachamara — havu la bene girdane. deachla chardela — havu la bene zalzelane. deachla tachle — havu la bene dulefane. deachla monine — havu la bene metzitze ena. deachla gargusheta — havu la bene mechoare. deshatya shichra — havu la bene ukkame. deachla bisra veshatya chamra — havu la bene

a: Barye. deachla bee — havu la bene enane. deachla kevore — havu la bene chinnane. deachla karpesa — havu la bene zivtane. deachla kusebarta — havu la bene bisrane. deachla etroga — havu la bene rechane. beratte deshabbur malka achala ba amma etroga, vahavo masseki la lekammeh avu beresh rechane.

Amar rav huna, bedak lan rav huna bar chinnana: hi omeret lehanik, vehu omer shello lehanik — shomin lah. tzaara dida hu. hu omer lehanik, vehi omeret shello lehanik, mahu? kol hecha delav orcha — shomin lah. hi orcha vehu lav orcheh, may? batar dideh azlinan, o batar dida azlinan?

Ufashetna leh meha: ola immo veenah yoredet immo. amar rav huna: may keraa — "vehi beulat baal", baaliyyayto shel baal, velo biridato shel baal. rabbi elazar amar mehacha: "ki hi hayta em kol chay", lechayyim nittena, velo letzaar nittena.
Hichnisa lo shifcha vechulei. ha sheara avda. vetema leh: ayyelit lach itteta bacharikay! mishshum deamar la: ha tarcha ledidi uledida, kamme didach man tarach?

Shetayim enah mevashshelet veenah menika vechulei. ha sheara avda. vetema leh: ayyelit lach itteta achariti detarcha ledidi uledida, vachada ledidach uledida! mishshum deamar la: kamme orche ufarche man tarach?
Shalosh, enah matztzaat hammitta. ha sheara avda. vetema leh: ayyelit lach achariti leorche ufarche! mishshum deamar la: nefish bene veta, nefish orche ufarche.
I hachi, afillu arba name! arba, kevan dinfishi lehu, mesayyeyan ahadade.
Amar rav chana veittema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: lo hichnisa lo mammash, ella kevan sheruya lehachenis, af al pi shello hichnisa. tana: echad shehichnisa lo, veechad shetztzimtzema lo mishshellah.
Arba, yoshevet bekatedra. amar rav yitzchak bar chananya amar rav huna: af al pi sheamru yoshevet bekatedra, aval mozeget lo kos umatztzaat lo et hammitta vmarchetzet lo panav yadav veraglav.
Amar rav yitzchak bar chananya amar rav huna: kol melachot shehaishsha osa levalah, nidda osa levalah, chutz mimmezigat hakkos, vehatztzaat hammitta, veharechatzat panav yadav veraglav.

Vehatztzaat hammitta. amar rava: la amaran ella befanav, aval shello befanav — let lan ba. umezigat hakkos. shemuel mechallefa leh devethu bida dismala. abbaye mannecha leh appumma dechubba. rava abbe sadya. rav pappa ashsharshifa.

Amar rav yitzchak bar chananya amar rav huna: hakkol meshahin bifne hashshammash, chutz mibbasar veyayin. amar rav chisda: basar shamen veyayin yashan. amar rava: basar shamen — kol hashshana kullah, yayin yashan — bitkufat tammuz.

Amar rav anan bar tachlifa: hava kaemna kammeh demar shemuel veayyto leh tavshila dearde, vei lav dihav li, istakkani. amar rav ashe: hava kaemna kammeh derav kahana veayyto leh gargelide delifta bechalla, vei lav dihav li, istakkani. rav pappa amar: afillu temarta dahanunita. kelala demilleta: kol deit leh recha veit leh kiyyuha.
Avu bar ihi uminyamin bar ihi, chad safe mikkol mina umina, vechad safe mechad mina. mar — mishtae eliyyahu bahadeh, umar — la mishtae eliyyahu bahadeh.
Hanhu tarten chaside, veamri la: rav mari verav pinchas bene rav chisda, mar kadem safe, umar meachar safe. dekadem safe — eliyyahu mishtae bahadeh, dimachar safe — la mishtae eliyyahu bahadeh.
Ammemar umar zutera verav ashe havu ka yatvi appitcha deve izgur malka. chalef veazel aturanga demalka. chazyeh rav ashe lemar zutera
b: Dachavavr appeh, shekal beetzbateh annach leh befummeh. amar leh: afsadt lisodta demalka. amaru leh: ammay tibed hachi? amar lehu: man deaved hachi pesil lemaachal demalka. amaru leh: ammay? amar lehu: davar acher chazay beh. bedaku vela ashkachu. shekal etzbateh, annach aleh, amar lehu: hacha mi badkitu? bedaku ashkachu. amaru leh rabbanan: may tama samchat annissa? amar lehu: chazay ruach tzaraat deka farcha illaveh.

Hahu romaa daamar lah lehahi itteta: minnasvat li? amara leh: la. azal ayyti ruymmane, palli vaachal kamma. kol mayya detzaari la, belateh, vela hav la ad dezag la. lesof amar la: i massena lach, minnasvat li? amara leh: in. azal ayyti ruymmane, palli vaachal kamma. amar la: kol mayya detzaari lich, tuf sheday tuf sheday! ad denafka minna ki hutza yarka veittesiat.

Veosa batztzemer. betzemer in, befishtim la. matnitin manni — rabbi yehuda hi. detanya: eno kofah lo laamod lifne aviv, velo laamod lifne veno, velo litten teven lifne vehemto. aval kofah litten teven lifne vekaro. rabbi yehuda omer: af eno kofah laasot befishtan, mippene sheppishtan masriach et happe, umesharbet et hassefatayim. vehane mille bechittana romaa.
Rabbi eliezer omer: afillu hichnisa lo mea shefachot. amar rav malkiyyo amar rav adda bar ahava: halacha kerabbi eliezer.
Amar rabbi chanina bereh derav ika: shappud, shefachot vegumot — rav malkiyyo.
Belorit, efer mikle ugevina — rav malkiyya.
Rav pappa amar: matnitin umatnita — rav malkiyya. shematata — rav malkiyyo. vesimanach: matnita malketa. may benayyhu — ikka benayyhu shefachot.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechulei. hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu demittallela begureyayta kitanyayta venadreshir.
Mishna hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta, bet shammay omrim: shete shabbatot. bet hillel omrim: shabbat achat.

Hattalmidim yotzin letalmud tora shello birshut sheloshim yom. happoalim shabbat achat. haona haamura battora: hattayyaylin — bechol yom. happoalim — shetayim beshabbat. hachammarim — achat beshabbat. haggammalim — achat lishloshim yom. hassappanim — achat leshishsha chodashim. divre rabbi eliezer.
Gemara may tama devet shammay? gamri miyyoledet nekeva. uvet hillel? gamri miyyoledet zachar.
Uvet hillel name nigmeru miyyoledet nekeva! i miyyoledet gamri la — hachi name, ella bet hillel minnidda gamri la.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: midde dishchiach mimmidde dishchiach, umar savar: midde dehu garem la mimmidde dehu garem la.
Amar rav: machloket bimfaresh, aval bistam — divre hakkol yotzi lealtar veyitten ketubba. ushemuel amar: afillu bistam name yamtin, shemma yimtza petach lenidro.

Ha peligi ba chada zimna, ditnan: hammaddir et ishto millehanot lo, ad sheloshim yom — yaamid parnas, yoter mikkan — yotzi veyitten ketubba. veamar rav: lo shanu ella bimfaresh, aval bistam — yotzi lealtar veyitten ketubba. ushemuel amar: afillu bistam name yamtin, shemma yimtza petach lenidro!

Tzericha, dei ittemar beha: beha kaamar rav — mishshum dela efshar befarnas, aval behahi deefshar befarnas — ema mode leh lishmuel. vei ittemar behahi — behach kaamar shemuel, aval beha — ema mode leh lerav, tzericha.
Hattalmidim yotzin letalmud vechulei. birshut kamma? kamma devae.

a: Orcha demilleta kamma? amar rav: chodesh kan, vechodesh babbayit. shenneemar: "lechol devar hammachlekot habbaa vehayyotzet chodesh bechodesh lechol chodshe hashshana". verabbi yochanan amar: chodesh kan ushenayim beveto, shenneemar: "chodesh yihyu vallevanon shenayim chodashim beveto".
Verav name, may tama la amar mehahi? shane binyan bet hammikdash, deefshar al yede acherim: verabbi yochanan may tama la amar mehahi? shane hatam, deit leh harevavcha.

Amar rav: anacha shoveret chatzi gufo shel adam, shenneemar: "veatta ven adam heanach beshivron motnayim uvimrirut teanach". verabbi yochanan amar: af kol gufo shel adam, shenneemar: "vehaya ki yomru elecha al ma atta neenach veamarta el shemua chi vaa venames kol lev verafu chol yadayim vechihata chol ruach vechol birkayim telachna mayim".

Verabbi yochanan name, hachtiv "beshivron motnayim"! hahi dechi matchala — mimmotnayim matchala. verav name, hachtiv: "venames kol lev verafu chol yadayim vechihata chol ruach"! shane shemua devet hammikdash, detakkifa tuva.

Hahu yisrael vegoy dahavo kaazli beorcha bahade hadade. la immetzi goy lesaggoye bahade yisrael. adkereh chureban bet hammikdash, negid veittenach, vaafillu hachi la immetzi goy lesaggoye bahadeh. amar leh: lav amritu "anacha shoveret chatzi gufo shel adam"? amar leh: hane mille milleta chadti, aval ha dashnan bah — la. deamri inashe: (demallefi) [demallefa] tichle — la bahata.

Hattayyaylin bechol yom. may "tayyaylin"? amar rava: bene firke. amar leh abbaye: man dichtiv behu "shav lachem mashkime kum meachare shevet ochle lechem haatzavim ken yitten lidido shena", veamar rav yitzchak: ellu neshotehen shel talmide chachamim, shemmenaddedot shena meenehem baolam hazze, uvaot lechayye haolam habba, veat amrat bene firke?!

Ella amar abbaye: kidrav, deamar rav: kegon rav shemuel bar shilat, deachel middideh, veshate middideh, vegane betulla deappadneh, vela chalef peristeka demalka abbaveh. ki ata ravin amar: kegon mefanneki demareva.

Rabbi avahu hava kae be vane. havo samchi leh tere avde. ippechit be vane mittuteh, itremi leh ammuda, selek veassekinhu. rabbi yochanan hava kasalek bedarga, havo samchi leh rav amme verav assi. ippechita darga tuteh, selek veassekinhu. amri leh rabbanan: vechi meachar dehachi, lema leh lemismecheh? amar lehu: im ken ma anniach leet zikna?

Vehappoalim shetayim bashshabbat. vehatanya: happoalim achat bashshabbat! amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina, la kashya: kan beosin melacha beiran, kan beosin melacha beir acheret. tanya name hachi: happoalim shetayim bashshabbat, bamme devarim amurim — beosin melacha beiran, aval beosin melacha beir acheret — achat bashshabbat.
Hachammarim achat bashshabbat. amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye: ikkefal tanna leashmoinan tayyayl ufoel? amar leh: la,
b: Akkullehu. veha shishsha chodashim kaamar? eno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo pat besallo.
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye: chammar venaase gammal, may? amar leh: rotza ishsha bekav vetiflut measara kabbin uferishut.

Hassappanim achat leshishsha chodashim, divre rabbi eliezer. amar rav berona amar rav: halacha kerabbi eliezer. amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav: zo divre rabbi eliezer, aval chachamim omrim: hattalmidim yotzin letalmud tora shetayim veshalosh shanim shello birshut. amar rava: samchu rabbanan adderav adda bar ahava veavdi ovada benafshayyhu.

Ki ha derav rechumi hava shechiach kammeh derava bemachoza, hava regil dahava ate leveteh kol maale yoma dechippure. yoma chad meshachteh shemata. hava mesakkeya devethu: hasheta ate, hasheta ate. la ata. chalash data, achit dimata meena. hava yatev beiggara, ippechit iggara mittuteh venach nafsheh.

Ona shel talmide chachamim emat? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. "asher piryo yitten beitto", amar rav yehuda, veittema rav huna, veittema rav nachman: ze hameshammesh mittato meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.

Yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay, chatneh derabbi yannay, hava azel veyatev beve rav, vechol be shimshe hava ate leveteh, vechi hava ate, hava ka chaze kammeh ammuda denura. yoma chad meshachteh shemata. kevan dela chaze hahu simana, amar lehu rabbi yannay: kefu mittato, sheilmale yehuda kayyaym lo bittel onato. havay kishgaga sheyyotza millifne hashshallit", venach nafsheh.

Rabbi iasek leh livreh be rabbi chiyyay, ki meta lemichtav ketubba nach nafsha dirvita. amar rabbi: chas veshalom pesula ikka? yetivu veayyinu bemishpachot, rabbi ate mishshefatya ben avital, verabbi chiyyay ate mishshimi achi david.

Azal iasek leh livreh be rabbi yose ben zimra. pesaku leh tarte sere shenin lemezal beve rav. achlefuha kammeh, amar lehu: nihvo shet shenin. achlefuha kammeh, amar lehu: echnoys vahadar ezil. hava ka mikkesif meavu. amar leh: beni, daat koncha yesh bach —
Meikkara ketiv: "teviemo vetittaemo", ulevassof ketiv: "veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham".

Azal yetev tarte sere shene beve rav. ad daata, iakara devethu. amar rabbi: hechi naaved, negarshah — yomru: aniyyay zo lashshav shimmera. ninnesiv itteta achariti — yomru: zo ishto, vezo zonato. bea ala rachame veittassiat.

Rabbi chananya ben chachinay hava kaazel leve rav beshilhe hilluleh derabbi shimon ben yochay, amar leh: iakkav li ad deate bahadach. la iakkav leh. azal yetev tere sere shene beve rav. ad deate, ishtanno shevile demata vela yeda lemezal leveteh.

Azal yetev aggudda denahara. shema lehahi revita dahavo karu la: "bat chachinay, bat chachinay, mallay kulletich veta nezil". amar: shema minna hay revita didan. azal batra. hava yetiva devethu ka nahala kimcha, dal ena chaziteh, sevi libba, perach rucha, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, aniyyay zo ze secharah?! bea rachame ala v[a]chayay.

Rabbi chama bar besa azayl yetev tere sere shene beve midresha. ki ata, amar: la eeved kidaved ben chachinay. ayel yatev be[10] midresha, shelach leveteh. ata rabbi oshaya bereh, yatev kammeh. hava ka meshael leh shemata, chaza deka mechaddedi shematateh, chalash dateh, amar: i havay hacha, hava li zera ki hay.

Al leveteh, al bereh, kam kammeh. hu savar lemishaleh shemateta ka vae, amara leh devethu: mi ikka abba dekaem mikkamme bera? kare aleh rame bar chama: "hachut hameshullash lo bimhera yinnatek" — ze rabbi oshaya beno shel rabbi chama bar besa.

Rabbi akiva raaya deven kalba savua hava, chaziteh beratte dahava tzenia umealle, amara leh: i mikkaddashna lach, azlat leve rav? amar la: in, ikkaddasha leh betzina veshaddarteh. shema avuha, appeka mibbeteh addera hanaa minnichseh. azal yetev tere sere shenin beve rav. ki ata, ayyti bahadeh tere sere alfe talmide. shameh lehahu sava dekaamar la: ad kamma

a: Ka middabberat almenut chayyim?! amara leh: i ledidi tzayet — yatev tere sere shene achraynyay[ta]. amar: birshut ka avedna. hadar azel veyatev tere sere shene achraynyay[ta] beve rav. ki ata ayyti bahadeh esrin vearbea alfe talmide, shemaa devethu, havat ka nafka leappeh. amaru la shivavata: sheili mane levosh veikkassay. amara lehu: "yodea tzaddik nefesh behemto". ki matya legabbeh, nefala al appa, ka menashsheka leh lechareh. havo ka medachafi la shammaeh. amar lehu: shivkuha, shelli veshellachem — shellah hu.

Shema avuha daata gavra rabba lemata, amar: ezil legabbeh, efshar demefar nidray. ata legabbeh, amar leh: addata degavra rabba mi nedart? amar lo: afillu perek echad, vaafillu halacha achat. amar leh: ana hu. nefal al appeh venashshekeh al kareh vihav leh palga mamoneh. beratte derabbi akiva avada leh leven azzay hachi. vehayeynu deamri inashe: rechela batar rechela azla, keovade imma kach ovade beratta.

Rav yosef bereh derava shaddereh avuhi leve rav lekammeh derav yosef. pesaku leh shet shene. ki hava telat shene, meta maale yoma dechippure, amar: ezil veechzinhu leinashe beti. shema avuhi, shekal mana unefak leappeh. amar leh: zonatcha nizkarta? ikka deamri amar leh: yonatcha nizkarta? itterud. la mar ippesik, vela mar ippesik.

Mishna hammoredet al balah — pochatin lah mikketubbatah shiva dinarin bashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer: shiva tarpeikin. ad matay hu pochet — ad keneged ketubbatah. rabbi yose omer: leolam hu pochet veholech, ad sheim tippol lah yerushsha mimmakom acher, gova hemenna. vechen, hammored al ishto — mosifin al ketubbatah shelosha dinarin beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer: shelosha tarpeikin.

Gemara moredet mimmay? rav huna amar: mittashmish hammitta. rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: mimmelacha. tenan: vechen hammored al ishto. bishlama leman deamar mittashmish, lechayye. ella leman deamar mimmelacha, mi meshuebad la? in, beomer "eni zan veeni mefarnes".
Vehaamar rav: haomer "eni zan veeni mefarnes" — yotzi veyitten ketubba! velav leimmeloche beh bae?
Metivi: achat li arusa, unesua, vaafillu nidda, vaafillu chola, vaafillu shomeret yavam.
Bishlama leman deamar mimmelacha, shappir. ella leman deamar mittashmish — nidda bat tashmish hi? amar lach: eno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo.
Ikka deamri: bishlama leman deamar mittashmish, hayeynu dekatane chola.
b: Ella leman deamar mimmelacha, chola bat melacha hi? ella: mittashmish kulle alma la peligi dehavya moredet. ki peligi mimmelacha, mar savar: mimmelacha — la havya moredet, umar savar: mimmelacha — name havya moredet.

Gufa: hammoredet al baalah — pochatin lah mikketubbatah shiva dinarim beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer: shiva tarpeikin. rabbotenu chazru venimnu, sheyyehu machrizin aleha arba shabbatot zo achar zo, vesholchin lah bet din: hevi yodaat sheafillu ketubbatich mea mane hifsadt. achat li arusa unesua, afillu nidda, afillu chola, vaafillu shomeret yavam.
Amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar yosef lishmuel: nidda bat tashmish hi? amar leh: eno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo pat besallo.

Amar rame bar chama: en machrizin aleha ella bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot. amar rava: dayka name, dekatane: arba shabbatot zo achar zo. shema minna. amar rame bar chama: paamayim sholchin lah mibbet din, achat kodem hacheraza, veachat leachar hacheraza.
