Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda: halacha kerabbotenu. amar rava: hay burecha. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak: may burechateh? ana amrita nihaleh, umishshemeh degavra rabba amrita nihaleh, umannu, rabbi yose berabbi chanina.
Veihu keman savar? ki ha deittemar: rava amar rav sheshet: halacha, nimlachin bah. rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet: halacha, en nimlachin bah.
Hechi damya moredet? amar ammemar: deamra "baena leh umetzaarna leh". aval amra "meis alay" — la kayyfinan la. mar zutera amar: kayyfinan lah.
Hava ovada veachpeya mar zutera, unefak minneh rabbi chanina missura. vela hi: hatam siyyayta dishmayya hava.

Kalleteh derav zevid immerada, hava tefisa chad shera. yetev ammemar umar zutera verav ashe, vitev rav gammada gabbayyhu. yatvi vekaamri: marda — hifsida belaoteha kayyaymin. amar lehu rav gammada: mishshum derav zevid gavra rabba, machnifitu leh? vehaamar rav kahana: mibbaya bae rava, vela peshit? ikka deamri, yatvi vekaamri, marda — lo hifsida belaoteha kayyaymin. amar lehu rav gammada:

a: Mishshum derav zevid gavra rabba hu, afchitu leh ledina illaveh? haamar rav kahana: mibbaya bae la rava, vela peshit?! hasheta dela ittemar la hachi vela hachi, tefasa — la mappekinan minna, la tefasa — la yahavinan la.
Umeshahenan la teresar yarche shatta aggitta, uvehanach teresar yarche shatta let la mezone mibbaal.
Amar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel: kotvin iggeret mared al arusa, veen kotvin iggeret mared al shomeret yavam. metivi: achat li arusa unesua, afillu nidda, afillu chola, vaafillu shomeret yavam!
La kashya: kan shettava hu, kan shettava hi. deamar rav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel: tava hu — nizkakin lo. tava hi — en nizkakin lah.
Bemay okemta leha dishmuel — beshettava hi, hay "kotvin iggeret mered al arusa"? "laarusa" mibbee leh! ha la kashya, teni "laarusa".
May shena shomeret yavam dela — deamrinan la: zil, la mippakkedat, arusa name, nema la: zil, la mippakkedat! ella bevaa mechamat taana, deamra: baena chutera lida umara likvura.

Hachi name shomeret yavam, bevaa mechamat taana?! ella, idde veidde shettava hu, vela kashya: kan lachalotz, vechan leyaybem. deamar rabbi pedat amar rabbi yochanan: tava lachlotz — nizkakin lo. tava leyaybem — en nizkakin lo.
May shena leyaybem dela, deamrinan leh: zil unesev itteta achariti. lachlotz name nema leh: zil unesev itteta achariti!
Ella deamar: "kevan daagida bi, la ka yahavu li achariti".
Hacha name: "kevan daagida bi, la ka yahavu li achariti"! ella idde veidde shettava leyaybem, vela kashya: kan — kemishna rishona, kan — kemishna acharona.
Ditnan: mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza — barishona, shehayu mitkavvevnin leshum mitzva. achshav sheen mitkavvevnin leshum mitzva, amru: mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum.

Ad matay hu pochet vechulei. may tarpeikin? amar rav sheshet: istera. vechamma istera — palga dezuza. tanya name hachi, rabbi yehuda omer: shelosha tarpeikin, shehen tesha meen, maa vachatzi lechol yom.

Amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar yosef lishmuel: may shena ihu deyahavinan leh deshabbat. umay shena ihi dela yahavinan la deshabbat? ihi demifchat ka fachet, la michaze kischar shabbat, ihu deosofe ka mosfa,
b: Michaze kischar shabbat.
Amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar yosef lishmuel: ma ben mored lemoredet? amar leh: tze ulemad mishshuk shel zonot, mi socher et mi? davar acher: ze yitzro mibbachutz, vezo yitzrah mibbifnim.

Mishna hammashre et ishto al yede shalish — lo yifchot lah mishshene kabbin chittin, o mearbaa kabbin seorin. amar rabbi yose: lo pasak lah seorin ella rabbi yishmael, shehaya samuch leedom. venoten lah chatzi kav kitnit, vachatzi log shemen, vekav gerogrot o mane devela. veim en lo — posek leummatan perot mimmakom acher.

Venoten lah mitta, mappatz umachtzelet. venoten lah kippa leroshah, vachagor lemotneha, uminalim mimmoed lemoed, vechelim shel chamishshim zuz mishshana leshana. veen notnin lah lo chadashim bimot hachamma, velo shechakim bimot haggeshamim. ella noten lah kelim shel chamishshim zuz bimot haggeshamim, vehi mitkassa bivlaotehen bimot hachamma. vehashshechakim — shellah.
Noten lah maa kesef letzorkah. veochelet immo millele shabbat lelele shabbat. veim en noten lah maa kesef letzorkah — maase yadeha shellah.

Uma hi osa lo? mishkal chamesh selaim sheti bihuda, shehen eser selaim baggalil. o mishkal eser selaim erev bihuda, shehen esrim selaim baggalil. veim hayta menika — pochatin lah mimmaase yadeha, umosifin lah al mezonoteha. bamme devarim amurim — beani shebbeyisrael, aval bimchubbad hakkol lefi kevodo.

Gemara manni matnitin, la rabbi yochanan ben beroka, vela rabbi shimon. ditnan: vechamma shiuro — mezon shete seudot lechol echad veechad. mezono lachol velo lashshabbat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: lashshabbat velo lachol. veze vaze mitkavvevnin lehakel.
Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: kikkar hallakuach befunedyon, mearba sein lesela. rabbi shimon omer: shete yadot lakkikkar, mishshalosh kikkarot lakkav.
Chetzyah — levayit hamenugga. vachatzi chetzyah — lifsol et haggeviyyay. vachatzi chatzi chetzyah — lekabbel tumeat ochalin.
Manni? i rabbi yochanan ben beroka, tamne havyayn! vei rabbi shimon, tamne sere havyayn!
Leolam rabbi yochanan ben beroka, vechidamar rav chisda: tze mehen shelish lachenvoni. hacha name: ayyti tilta shedi alayyhu. akkatti tarte sere havyayn! ochelet immo lele shabbat.

Hanicha leman deamar achila mammash. ella leman deamar achila tashmish, may ikka lememar? veod, telesar havyayn! ella kidamar rav chisda, tze mehen mechetza lachenvoni. hachi name ayti palga ushedi alayyhu.
Kashya derav chisda adderav chisda! la kashya: ha beatra deyahavi tzive, ha beatra dela yahavi tzive.
I hachi, shittasre havyayn. keman, kerabbi chidka, deamar: arba seudot chayyayv adam leechol bashshabbat.
Afillu tema rabbanan, dal chada learche ufarche.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, afillu tema rabbi shimon: lerabbanan — dal telat learche ufarche, lerabbi chidka — dal tarte learche ufarche.

Amar rabbi yose: lo pasak seorin vechulei. ella beedom hu deachlin seorim, bechulle alma la achli! hachi kaamar: lo pasak seorim kiflayim bechittin ella rabbi yishmael shehaya samuch leedom, mippene shesseorin adomiyyot raot hen.
Venoten lah chatzi kav kitnit. veillu yayin la katane. mesayyay leh lerabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar

a: En poskin yenot laishsha, veim tomar: "elcha achare meahavay notne lachmi umemay tzamri ufishti shamni veshikkuyay" — devarim shehaishsha mishtokeket alehen, umay ninhu — tachshitin.

Daresh rabbi yehuda ish kefar nevirya, veamri la ish kefar nefor chayil: minnayin sheen poskin yenot laishsha — shenneemar: "vattakom channa achare ochla veshilo veachare shato". "shata", velo "shatat".
Ella meatta "achla" velo "ochlo", hachi name?! anan middeshanni kera bedibbureh kaamrinan. mikkede begavva ka asek veate, may tama shanni? shema minna "shata" velo "shatat".
Metivi: regila — notnin lah! regila shane, deamar rav chinnana bar kahana amar shemuel: regila — notnin lah kos echad. sheenah regila — notnin lah shene kosot.

May kaamar?! amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: regila, bifne balah — shene kosot, shello bifne valah — notnin lah kos echad. enah regila, bifne valah — ella kos echad, shello bifne valah — en notnin lah kol ikkar.

Vei baet ema: regila, notnin lah letzike kedera. deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: maase bechallato shel nakdimon ben gureyon sheppasku lah chachamim satayim yayin letzike kedera meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. amra lahen: kach tifseku livnotechem. tana: shomeret yavam hayta, velo anu achareha amen.

Tana: kos echad — yafe laishsha. shenayim — niuul hu. shelosha — tovaat bappe. arbaa — afillu chamor tovaat bashshuk veenah makpedet. amar rava: lo shanu ella sheen balah immah. aval balah immah, let lan ba.

Veha channa, devalah immah havay! achsenay shane. deamar rav huna: minnayin leachsenay sheasur betashmish hammitta, shenneemar: "vayyashkimu vabboker vayyishtachavu lifne Adonai vayyashuvu vayyavou el betam haramata vayyeda elkana et channa ishto vayyizkereha Adonai", hasheta — in, meikkara — la.

Chuma devethu deabbaye atay lekammeh derava, amara leh: pesok li mezone! pesak la. pesok li chamra! amar leh: yadana beh benachmani dela hava shate chamra. amara leh: chayye demar dahava mashke li beshuferaze ki hay. bahade deka machveya leh iggalli deraa, nefal nehora beve dina.

Kam rava, al leveteh tava levat rav chisda. amara leh bat rav chisda: man havay haiddana beve dina? amar la: chuma devethu deabbaye. nafka abbatra, machata lah bekulefe deshidda ad deappeka la mikkulle machoza. amra la: ketalt lich telata, veatet lemiktal acharina?!
Devethu derav yosef bereh derava atay lekammeh derav nechemya bereh derav yosef. amara leh: pesok li mezone! pesak la. pesok li chamra! pesak la. amar la: yadana behu bivne machoza deshatu chamra.

Devethu derav yosef bereh derav menashsheya middevil atay lekammeh derav yosef. amara leh: pesok li mezone! pesak la. pesok li chamra! pesak la. pesok li shirae! amar la: shirae lema? amara leh: lach ulechavrach ulechavrurach.
Venoten lah mitta umappatz vechulei. mappatz umachtzelet lema la deyahev la? amar rav pappa: beatra dinhigi demalu pureya bechavle, demavgar la.
Tanu rabbanan: en notnin lah kar vacheset. mishshum rabbi natan amru: notnin lah kar vacheset. hechi dame: i deorcha, may tama detanna kamma? vei delav orcha, may tama derabbi natan?

La tzericha, kegon deorcheh dideh velav orcha dida. tanna kamma savar, amar la: ki azelna shakelna lehu, vechi atena, mayytena lehu bahaday. verabbi natan savar: amara leh: zimnin demitreme ben hashshemashot vela matzet mayytet lehu, veshaklat lehu ledidi umagnet li al ara.
Venoten lah kippa. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye:
b: Hay tanna sheliach artilay ureme mesane! amar leh: tanna bimkom harim kae, dela saggi bela telata zuge mesane. veaggav orcheh ka mashma lan denittevinhu nihala bammoed, ki hechi denehve la simcha begavvayyhu.

Vechelim shel chamishshim zuz. amar abbaye: chamishshim zuze peshite. mimmay? middekatane: bamme devarim amurim — beani shebbeyisrael, aval bimchubbad — hakkol lefi kevodo. vei salka datach chamishshim zuz mammash, ani, chamishshim zuz mena leh? ella shema minna chamishshim zuze peshite.

Veen notnin lah lo chadashim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: motar mezonot labbaal, motar belaot laishsha. motar belaot laishsha, lema la? amar rachava: shemmitkassa bahen bime niddatah, kede shello titganne al balah.
Amar abbaye: naktinan, motar belaot almana leyorshav. hatam hu dela titganne beappeh, hacha — titganne vetitganne.
Noten lah maa kesef vechulei. may "ochelet"? rav nachman amar: ochelet mammash. rav ashe amar: tashmish.

Tenan: ochelet immo lele shabbat. bishlama leman deamar achila — hayeynu dekatane "ochelet", ella leman deamar tashmish, may "ochelet"? lishshana mealleya, kedichtiv: "achla umachata fiha veamra lo faalti aven".

Metivi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ochelet belele shabbat veshabbat. bishlama leman deamar achila — hayeynu dekatane "veshabbat". ella leman deamar tashmish — tashmish beshabbat mi ikka? vehaamar rav huna: yisrael kedoshim hen, veen meshammeshin mittotehen bayyom! haamar rava: bevayit afel muttar.
Veim hayta menika. daresh rabbi ulla rabba appitcha deve nesia: af al pi sheamru en adam zan et banav uvenotav keshehen ketannim, aval zan ketanne ketannim.
Ad kamma — ad ben shesh, kidrav assi. deamar rav assi: katan ben shesh yotze beeruv immo.
Mimmay? middekatane: hayta menika — pochatin lah mimmaase yadeha, umosifin lah al mezonoteha. may tama? lav mishshum devae lemechal bahada? vedilma mishshum dechola hi.
Im ken, litne "im hayta chola", may im hayta menika? vedilma ha ka mashma lan distam menikot cholot ninhu. ittemar, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mosifin lah yayin, shehayyayin yafe lechalav.
Hadaran alach af al pi
Metziat haishsha umaase yadeha levalah. virushshatah — hu ochel perot bechayyeha. boshtah, ufegamah — shellah.

Rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: bizman shebbasseter — lah shene chalakim, velo echad. uvizman shebbaggaluy lo shene chalakim, velah echad. shello yinnaten miyyad, veshellah yilkach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot.

Gemara may ka mashma lan? tenena haav zakkay bevitto bekiddusheha, bechesef, bishtar uvevia. zakkay bimtziatah uvemaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha. mekabbel et gittah, veeno ochel perot bechayyeha. nisset — yater alav habbaal, shehu ochel perot bechayyeha.
Boshtah ufegamah itztericha leh, pelugeta derabbi yehuda ben betera verabbanan.
Tane tanna kammeh derava: metziat haishsha leatzmah. rabbi akiva omer: levalah. amar leh: hasheta uma haadafa,

a: Demaase yadeha hi, amar rabbi akiva leatzmah — metziatah lo kol shekken?!
Ditnan: "kuvnnam sheani osa leficha" — eno tzarich lehafer. rabbi akiva omer: yafer, shemma taadif alav yoter min harauy lo! ella efoch: metziat haishsha levalah. rabbi akiva omer: leatzmah.

Veha ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: behaedafa shello al yede haddechak — kulle alma la peligi devaal have. ki peligi behaedafa sheal yede haddechak: tanna kamma savar levalah, verabbi akiva savar leatzmah. amar rav pappa: metziatah kehaedafa sheal yede haddechak dame. pelugeta derabbi akiva verabbanan.
Bae rav pappa: asta lo shetayim bevat achat, mahu? bae ravina: shelosha o arbaa bevat achat, mahu? teku.

Boshtah ufegamah. matkef la rava bar rav chanan: ella meatta, biyyesh susato shel chavero, hachi name devae lemittan leh boshet? vesus bar boshet hu?! ella: rakak bevigdo shel chavero, hachi name devae lemittan leh boshet?

Vechi tema hachi name — vehatnan: rakak vehiggia bo harok, ufara rosh haishsha, veheevir tallito mimmennu — chayyayv litten lo arba meot zuz. veamar rav pappa: lo shanu ella bo, aval bevigdo — patur! bevigdo — let leh ziluta, ishto — it la ziluta.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ella meatta, biyyesh ani ben tovim, deit lehu ziluta lechullehu bene mishpacha, hachi name devae lemittan lehu boshet lechol bene mishpacha? amar leh: hatam — lav gufayyhu, hacha — ishto gufeh hi.
Mishna happosek maot lachatano, umet chatano, amru chachamim: yachol hu sheyyomar: leachicha hayiti rotze litten, velach i efshi litten.
Paska lehachenis lo elef dinar — hu posek kenegdan chamesh esre mane, ucheneged hashshum hu posek pachot chomesh.
Shum bemane veshave mane — en lo ella mane. shum bemane, hi notenet sheloshim veechad sela vedinar. uvearba meot, hi notenet chamesh meot. ma
b: Shechatan posek — hu posek pachot chomesh.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: en tzarich lomar rishon talmid chacham vesheni am haaretz, ella afillu rishon am haaretz vesheni talmid chacham, yachol lomar: leachich hayiti rotze litten, lecha i efshi litten.
Paska lehachenis lo elef dinar kulei. hayeynu resha! tena shuma rabba vekatane shuma zuta. tena shuma dideh, vekatane shuma dida.
Mishna paska lehachenis lo kesafim — salah naase shishsha dinarin. hechatan mekabbel alav asara dinarim lakkuppa lechol mane umane. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hakkol keminhag hammedina.
Gemara hayeynu posek kenegdam chamishsha asar mane!

Tena iska rabba, utena iska zuta. utzericha, dei tena iska rabba — dinfish ravvcha, aval iska zuta, dezutar ravvcha — ema la, tzericha. vei ashmeinan iska zuta — dezutar ziyyuna, aval iska rabba, dinfish ziyyuna — ema la, tzericha.
Hechatan mekabbel alav asara dinar lakkuppa. may kuppa? amar rav ashe: kuppa shel besamim. veamar rav ashe: lo neemru devarim hallalu ella birushalayim.
Bae rav ashe: bemane hannishshom, o bemane hammitkabbel?

Im timtza lomar mane hammitkabbel: yom rishon, o kol yom vayom? im timtza lomar kol yom vayom: shabbat rishona, o kol shabbat veshabbat? im timtza lomar kol shabbat veshabbat: chodesh rishon, o kol chodesh vachodesh? im timtza lomar kol chodesh vachodesh: shana rishona, o kol shana veshana? teku.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: maase bevitto shel nakdimon ben gureyon sheppasku lah chachamim arba meot zehuvim lakkuppa shel besamim levo bayyom. amra lahem: kach tifseku livnotechem, veanu achareha amen.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabban yochanan ben zakkay shehaya rochev al hachamor vehaya yotze mirushalayim, vehayu talmidav mehallechin acharav. raa riva achat shehayta melakketet seorim mibben gelle vehemtan shel arviyyim. kevan sheraata oto, nitattefa bisarah veamda lefanav.

Amra lo: rabbi, parneseni. amar lah: bitti, mi at? amra lo: bat nakdimon ben gureyon ani. amar la: bitti, mamon shel bet avicha hechan halach? amra lo: rabbi, la keden matlin matla birushalayim: "melach mamon — cheser"? veamri la: "chesed". veshel bet chamich hechan hu? amra lo: ba ze veibbed et ze.

Amra lo: rabbi, zachur atta keshechatamta al ketubbati? amar lahen letalmidav: zachur ani keshechatamti al ketubbatah shel zo, vehayiti kore bah: elef alafim dinre zahav mibbet aviha, chutz mishshel chamiha. bacha rabban yochanan ben zakkay veamar: ashrechem yisrael, bizman sheosin retzono shel makom en kol umma velashon sholetet bahem, uvizman sheen osin retzono shel makom, mosran beyad umma shefala. velo beyad umma shefala, ella beyad behemtan shel umma shefala.
Venakdimon ben gureyon la avad tzedaka? vehatanya: amru alav al nakdimon ben gureyon keshehaya yotze mibbeto levet hammidrash, kele melat hayu
